Testing hypotheses drawn from four ideal-types depicting different approaches towards social media—imperatively impartial; politically minded, mindfully impartial; megaphone bureaucracy; promiscuously partisan—the empirical results suggest that bureaucrats’ social media activity has led to a paradoxical bifurcation of the bureaucracy into radically different realms of being imperatively impartial and promiscuously partisan. Responding to risk-averse messages from the bureaucracy itself, nonexecutive federal bureaucrats display remarkably low levels of political activity on social media. In contrast, responding to political pressure to promote the government’s messaging, top-ranking federal bureaucrats display high levels of political activity on social media, especially when it comes to partisan content such as reposting official party messages. This social media paradox points to a potentially tragic portrait for the future of governance in the twenty-first century, whereby the integrity of the bureaucracy’s reputed impartiality and the vitality of democratic society, both stand to lose.
papers.abstract_zh: 公務員在社群媒體上的政治活動日益受到各界觀察者的關注，他們爭論此類行為究竟是削弱了官僚體系聲稱的公正性，抑或是透過參與公共討論來創造公共價值。為深化此一辯論，本文運用來自加拿大的調查數據，探討公務員在社群媒體上的政治活動。本文檢驗了源自四種描繪對社群媒體不同取徑的理想類型（即：嚴格公正、政治導向但審慎公正、擴音器式官僚體系、濫情黨派）所提出的假設，實證結果顯示，公務員的社群媒體活動導致官僚體系出現矛盾的兩極分化，分裂為嚴格公正與濫情黨派兩種截然不同的領域。為了回應官僚體系內部規避風險的指示，非主管職聯邦公務員在社群媒體上的政治活動程度顯著偏低。相較之下，為了因應推廣政府訊息的政治壓力，高階聯邦公務員在社群媒體上的政治活動程度偏高，特別是涉及黨派內容時，例如轉發官方政黨訊息。此一社群媒體悖論預示著二十一世紀治理未來可能面臨的悲劇性局面，在此情況下，官僚體系聲稱的公正性之完整性與民主社會的活力，兩者皆將蒙受損失。

papers.title: Bureaucratic interest in academic evidence: a field experiment in Tanzania, India and Peru
papers.abstract: We investigate how different types of messaging by academics impact public servants’ behavioral demand for access to academic evidence by inviting nearly 9,000 national-level government bureaucrats in Tanzania, India and Peru to receive training on an original website that summarizes and graphically depicts findings from hundreds of randomized controlled trials. Implementing well-known interventions from the psychology of choice literature, we sought to test whether “nudges” might work across different national and bureaucratic contexts. We tested randomly assigned messaging characteristics related to messenger identity and social proof. In particular, we randomized whether invitations came from U.S. researchers on location or similar local researchers. We find that bureaucrats were significantly more responsive to U.S. researchers in Peru but not in India or Tanzania. We also randomly assigned information that other bureaucrats in the same ministry had previously expressed interest. Contrary to findings from other populations with similar “social proof” treatments, bureaucrats were less interested when informed that others had already accepted the demonstration. This novel finding is likely due to the institutional context of bureaucracies, where knowledge is more likely to be either a shared resource or a competitive advantage. In this context, others’ access to knowledge disincentivizes individual action rather than communicating a norm. This study offers evidence about some possible approaches and pitfalls to effective dissemination of academic evidence.
papers.abstract_zh: 我們探討學術界人士不同類型的訊息傳遞方式，如何影響公務員對獲取學術證據的行為需求。我們邀請坦尚尼亞、印度和秘魯近9,000名國家級政府官員，參與一個原創網站的培訓，該網站彙整並圖示化呈現數百項隨機對照試驗的結果。運用決策心理學文獻中廣為人知的干預措施，我們旨在檢驗「推力」（nudges）是否能在不同的國家和官僚體系背景下發揮作用。我們測試了隨機分配的訊息特徵，這些特徵與傳訊者身份和社會認同有關。特別是，我們隨機分配了邀請函是來自當地美國研究人員，還是來自類似的當地研究人員。我們發現，在秘魯，官員對美國研究人員的反應顯著更積極，但在印度或坦尚尼亞則不然。我們也隨機分配了關於同一部會其他官員先前已表達興趣的資訊。與其他群體在類似「社會認同」處理下的發現相反，當被告知其他官員已接受示範時，官員們的興趣反而降低了。這項新穎的發現可能歸因於官僚體系的制度背景，在此背景下，知識更可能是一種共享資源或競爭優勢。在這種情境下，他人獲取知識反而會抑制個體行動，而非傳達一種規範。本研究為有效傳播學術證據提供了一些可能的方法和潛在陷阱的證據。

papers.title: Toward a Gender Sensitive and Locally Rooted co‐Production Approach: Insights From Implementing Child Stunting Eradication Program in Indonesia
papers.abstract: Co‐production is a complex and nuanced field of social action that operates at multiple levels of the policy cycle, closely interconnecting the roles, motivations, and outcomes of different social actors. But how co‐production practices are shaped by gender is often overlooked. This article highlights the complexity of co‐production practices within Indonesia's ambitious national strategy to reduce child stunting. Based on qualitative research of three local government areas implementing stunting intervention programs, we draw on the ‘Four Co(s)’ framework to explore variations across co‐commissioning, co‐design, co‐delivery, and co‐assessment. Ongoing challenges to the eradication of stunting in some areas highlight the tense intersections between early marriage, poverty and rural and technological disadvantage. But as we argue, it is also dependent on social actors, especially women, who serve as catalysts. Future research that pays closer attention to the inherently gendered expressions of co‐production is both theoretically and practically necessary.
papers.abstract_zh: 協同生產是一個複雜且細緻的社會行動領域，它運作於政策週期的多個層次，並緊密連結不同社會行動者的角色、動機與成果。然而，協同生產實踐如何受性別形塑卻常被忽視。本文旨在探討印尼旨在減少兒童發育遲緩的雄心勃勃國家策略中，協同生產實踐的複雜性。根據對三個實施發育遲緩干預計畫的地方政府區域進行的質性研究，我們借鑒「四個共同」框架，探討共同委託、共同設計、共同交付與共同評估之間的變異。在某些地區，消除發育遲緩所面臨的持續挑戰，凸顯了早期婚姻、貧困以及鄉村與技術劣勢之間緊張的交織點。然而，正如我們所主張的，它也取決於扮演催化劑角色的社會行動者，特別是女性。未來的研究應更密切關注協同生產內在的性別化展現，這在理論和實踐上都具有必要性。

papers.title: Credit Attribution for Public Service Providers and Their Employees: Implications from Contracting Out
papers.abstract: Both government and government employees alike face negativity bias, but could conveying the exemplary work of public service help address declining public trust and engagement? While scholarly research has examined how the public assigns blame when the government or a contractor falls short, far less attention has been paid to the positive side. How is credit assigned to employees and agencies when they go above and beyond what is required in their jobs? This research addresses this gap through a vignette survey experiment, which is used to determine how contracting influences credit given to the service provider and the individual employee across levels of government –federal, state, and local. The results reveal that credit is more likely to be given to third-party providers than the government directly providing the service. However, at the individual employee level, the public prefers to give credit to public employees, especially at the federal government level, when outstanding work occurs. Findings have implications for contracting, performance, and accountability, where perhaps sharing more positive stories of public service can foster more positive public views.
papers.journal: The American Review of Public Administration
papers.abstract_zh: 政府與公務人員皆面臨負面偏誤，但傳達公務服務的卓越表現是否有助於解決公眾信任與參與度下降的問題？儘管學術研究已探討當政府或承包商表現不佳時，公眾如何歸咎責任，但對於正面層面的關注卻少得多。當員工與機構超越職責要求時，功勞是如何歸屬的？本研究透過情境問卷實驗來填補此一研究缺口，旨在探討契約外包如何影響公眾將功勞歸屬給聯邦、州及地方各級政府的服務提供者與個別員工。結果顯示，功勞更可能歸屬給第三方提供者，而非直接提供服務的政府。然而，在個別員工層面，當有卓越表現時，公眾偏好將功勞歸屬給公務人員，尤其是在聯邦政府層級。本研究結果對契約外包、績效與問責具有啟示，或許分享更多公務服務的正面故事能促進公眾更正向的看法。

papers.title: Balancing Neutral and Responsive Competences in the Context of Functional Politicization
papers.abstract: Democratic governments can legitimately expect permanent civil servants to undertake functionally politicized tasks, such as providing political‐tactical advice. However, safeguarding the neutrality and legitimacy of a permanent civil service in the context of functional politicization necessitates that political considerations do not override professional judgment or impede the delivery of free, frank and fearless advice. Although existing research has documented functional politicization in permanent civil services situated in different politico–administrative systems, its behavioral implications remain insufficiently explored. Drawing on a survey of 901 senior permanent civil servants in managerial positions across Denmark's central, regional and local governments, this study finds that the engagement in functionally politicized tasks is associated with a higher likelihood of altering or omitting professional input in response to perceived political pressures. However, the study finds no significant relationship between functional politicization and civil servants' willingness to voice concerns to their superiors, which suggests that their capacity to provide free, frank and fearless advice remains intact.
papers.abstract_zh: 民主政府可以合理地期望常任文官承擔功能性政治化任務，例如提供政治戰術性建議。然而，在功能性政治化的背景下，維護常任文官體系的中立性與正當性，必須確保政治考量不凌駕於專業判斷之上，或阻礙提供自由、坦率且無所畏懼的建議。儘管既有研究已記錄了位於不同政治行政體系中的常任文官體系的功能性政治化現象，但其行為意涵仍未獲得充分探討。本研究基於對來自丹麥中央、區域及地方政府中，擔任管理職位的901名資深常任文官的調查，發現參與功能性政治化任務，與在回應感知到的政治壓力時，改變或省略專業意見的可能性更高有關。然而，本研究並未發現功能性政治化與文官向其上級表達關切的意願之間存在顯著關係，這表明他們提供自由、坦率且無所畏懼建議的能力仍保持完整。

papers.title: Improving non-executive directors’ judgement quality through information provision: a mixed-method study
papers.abstract: This study examines how information provision influences judgement quality of non-executive directors in the semipublic sector. Based on insights from behavioural science, hypotheses were developed and tested using a mixed-methods design, combining an experiment (N = 101) and group interviews (N = 34). The experiment with non-executive directors provides evidence for a causal relationship between information diversity and integrative complexity in judgements – a core indicator of judgement quality. However, findings from group interviews also highlight the challenge of gathering information, without undermining the trust-based relationship with the CEO. Finally, neither information diversity nor simultaneous order mitigates confirmation bias.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究探討資訊提供如何影響半公營部門非執行董事的判斷品質。依據行為科學的見解，本研究發展並檢驗了假說，採用混合方法設計，結合實驗法 (N = 101) 和團體訪談 (N = 34)。針對非執行董事的實驗，證實了資訊多樣性與判斷中的整合複雜度之間存在因果關係，而整合複雜度是判斷品質的核心指標。然而，團體訪談的結果也突顯了在不損害與執行長 (CEO) 之間信任關係的前提下，蒐集資訊所面臨的挑戰。最後，無論是資訊多樣性還是同步順序，都無法減輕確認偏誤。

papers.title: Beyond monolithic state logic: how top-down accountability shapes policy implementation
papers.abstract: How does top-down accountability shape policy implementation? Drawing on institutional logics, this paper distinguishes two state sub-logics: ‘high-stakes context logic’ emphasizing centralized control during crises, and ‘routine governance logic’ allowing discretion during day-to-day administration. These sub-logics condition the perceived legitimacy of accountability demands, felt accountability, and behavioural responses. A survey experiment with over 800 public service respondents shows that, under high-stakes logic, intensified accountability progressively improve compliance, whereas under routine logic, moderate accountability produces optimal compliance, with high-intensity accountability yielding diminishing returns. These findings challenge binary views of accountability and reveal how within-logic variations may alter governance mechanisms.
papers.abstract_zh: 由上而下的課責機制如何形塑政策執行？本文援引制度邏輯，區辨出兩種國家次級邏輯：「高風險情境邏輯」強調危機時期的中央集權控制，以及「常規治理邏輯」允許日常行政中的裁量權。這些次級邏輯制約著課責要求的感知合法性、感知課責以及行為反應。一項針對八百多名公務人員受訪者的問卷實驗結果顯示，在高風險情境邏輯下，強化課責能逐步提升順從度；然而在常規治理邏輯下，適度課責能產生最佳順從度，而高強度課責則產生邊際效益遞減。這些研究發現挑戰了課責的二元觀點，並揭示了邏輯內部的變異如何改變治理機制。

papers.title: Bureaucracy Remade, Citizens Reconfigured: Accountability, Digitalization, and the Transformation of Public Administration
papers.abstract: Something quietly consequential has been unfolding within democratic institutions over the past 40 years, though it rarely announces itself in obvious ways.Two recent books, emerging from different corners of public administration scholarship, circle this transformation from distinct vantage points.Karl Löfgren and Patrik Hall's The New Public Bureaucracy, alongside the edited volume Digital Co-Production of Public Services: Citizens, Challenges and Cases, led by Taco Brandsen, Ina Radtke, A. Paula Rodriguez Müller, and Trui Steen, were not conceived as companions.They speak in different voices and address partially overlapping audiences.Yet, when read side by side, something sparks between them.The tension is not accidental.It is revealing.
papers.abstract_zh: 過去四十年來，民主體制內悄然發生著深具影響力的變化，儘管這些變化鮮少以顯而易見的方式呈現。兩本近期出版的書籍，分別來自公共行政學術領域的不同面向，從各自獨特的視角探討這項轉變。Karl Löfgren 和 Patrik Hall 合著的《新公共官僚體制》，以及由 Taco Brandsen、Ina Radtke、A. Paula Rodriguez Müller 和 Trui Steen 主編的合輯《公共服務數位協同生產：公民、挑戰與案例》，兩者並非被構思為配套作品。它們的論述語調各異，並面向部分重疊的讀者群。然而，當兩者並列閱讀時，卻能激盪出一些火花。這份張力並非偶然，它深具啟發性。

papers.title: Democratic Backsliding and Governance Outcomes: Measuring Administrative and Political Channels of Decline
papers.abstract: Democratic backsliding has emerged as a defining political challenge of the contemporary era, yet systematic cross‐national evidence linking it to governance outcomes remains scarce. This article argues that backsliding affects governance through two analytically distinct channels: a political accountability channel, whereby weakened contestation and oversight reduce the external costs of poor performance; and an administrative channel, through which executive politicization erodes meritocratic recruitment and bureaucratic impartiality. Using a country‐year panel of 86 countries from 1996 to 2024 and generalized structural equation models, we decompose the direct, indirect, and total effects of backsliding on government effectiveness, regulatory quality, and control of corruption across stages of democratic decline. The findings show that governance deterioration is stage‐specific, channel‐specific, and outcome‐specific, following a nonlinear, U‐shaped pattern in which complete erosion—rather than autocratic reversion—produces the largest governance losses.
papers.abstract_zh: 民主倒退已成為當代一個關鍵的政治挑戰，然而，將其與治理成果連結的系統性跨國證據仍然稀缺。本文主張，民主倒退透過兩個分析上截然不同的管道影響治理：一個是政治課責管道，藉此，弱化的競爭與監督降低了績效不佳的外部成本；另一個是行政管道，透過此，行政部門的政治化侵蝕了功績制招募與官僚公正性。運用涵蓋1996年至2024年間86個國家的國家-年度面板資料，並採用廣義結構方程模型，我們分解了民主倒退對於政府效能、法規品質與貪腐控制的直接、間接與總體效應，橫跨民主衰退的各個階段。研究結果顯示，治理惡化具有階段特定性、管道特定性與成果特定性，並呈現非線性、U型模式，其中，完全的侵蝕—而非專制復辟—導致了最大的治理損失。

papers.title: Sifting Through: Federal Separations in 2025 and Their Implications for Knowledge Loss and Agency Capacity
papers.abstract: The federal service experienced unprecedented turnover in the first year of the second Trump administration. Early reports have documented the substantial losses of personnel and the politicization and antagonism underlying those changes. This research breaks down separations over the past year, with a focus on the Deferred Resignation Program (DRP), to understand where turnover occurred and how it affected organizational knowledge and capacity. The analysis examines federal workforce data from January 2015 to December 2025 and reveals that the federal service lost substantial expertise and experience through both voluntary and involuntary means of separation. These results shed light on the fallout from 2025 executive actions, clarify the implications for government capacity, and point out prospective pathways for mitigating damages to the federal service moving forward.
papers.abstract_zh: 聯邦公務體系在第二屆川普政府執政第一年經歷了前所未有的離職潮。初步報告已揭示了大量人員流失，以及這些變革背後的政治化與對立。本研究剖析了過去一年的離職情況，聚焦於延遲辭職計畫 (DRP)，旨在了解離職發生的地點及其對組織知識與能力的影響。本分析檢視了從2015年1月至2025年12月的聯邦公務員數據，顯示聯邦公務體系透過自願與非自願兩種離職方式，流失了大量專業知識與經驗。本研究結果闡明了2025年行政命令的後果，釐清了對政府運作能力的影響，並指出未來減輕對聯邦公務體系損害的可能途徑。

papers.title: Experimental Evidence on the Effect of Decision Justification Strategies on Citizen Perceptions of Government
papers.abstract: Abundant literature documents a range of factors that shape citizen perceptions of government. However, attention to how the justification of a policy decision shapes citizen perceptions remains limited. In this study, we consider how justifications influence citizen trust and legitimacy through a 2 × 2 × 2 pre-registered factorial survey experiment that manipulates justification strategy, policy position, and policy type. Results indicate that opposing positions reduce trust and legitimacy while the context of a highly polarized policy has the opposite effect. Emotive-based strategies decrease trust but do not affect legitimacy. Further, the effect of a supportive or opposing position varies by level of policy polarization.
papers.journal: The American Review of Public Administration
papers.abstract_zh: 豐富文獻探討了形塑公民政府觀感的諸多因素。然而，對於政策決策的正當性如何形塑公民觀感的關注仍屬有限。本研究透過一項2 × 2 × 2預先註冊的因子式問卷實驗，探討政策正當性如何影響公民信任與政府合法性，該實驗操弄了正當化策略、政策立場與政策類型。結果顯示，對立立場會降低信任與合法性，而高度兩極化政策的情境則產生相反效果。情感訴求策略會降低信任，但不影響合法性。此外，支持或反對立場的效果會因政策兩極化程度而異。

papers.title: Coordination Costs and Homelessness Housing Form Choice
papers.abstract: Local implementers have discretion in selecting forms of housing for the homeless, yet the determinants of these choices remain poorly understood. Using the institutional collective action (ICA) framework, this study examines California's Homekey program to assess how coordination demands shape decisions among hotel conversions, multifamily acquisitions, and modular or new construction. Drawing on binary logistic, generalized estimating equation (GEE), and multinomial logistic models, we find that larger projects and those designated as permanent housing are significantly more likely to pursue hotel conversions. Housing authorities—owing to their specialized missions and lower form‐specific coordination costs—are over six times more likely than cities to select multifamily acquisition. Local vacancy constraints further steer implementers away from modular or new construction and toward hotel conversions. These results demonstrate that implementation form is not a neutral technical decision but an institutional response to coordination challenges embedded in intergovernmental and interorganizational contexts.
papers.abstract_zh:
地方執行者在選擇無家者住房形式方面擁有裁量權，然而這些選擇的決定因素仍鮮為人知。本研究運用制度性集體行動（ICA）架構，檢視加州的Homekey計畫，以評估協調需求如何形塑旅館改建、多戶住宅收購以及模組化或新建工程之間的決策。

本研究採用二元羅吉斯迴歸、廣義估計方程式（GEE）及多項羅吉斯迴歸模型，發現規模較大的專案以及被指定為永久性住房的專案，顯著更有可能選擇旅館改建。住宅主管機關由於其專業任務和較低的特定形式協調成本，選擇多戶住宅收購的可能性比市政府高出六倍以上。此外，當地空置限制進一步促使執行者避開模組化或新建工程，轉而選擇旅館改建。

這些結果顯示，實施形式並非中立的技術性決策，而是對根植於政府間與組織間脈絡中協調挑戰的制度性回應。

papers.title: Governing Street‐Level Bureaucracies: The Organizational Shaping of Caseworkers. By KerstinJacobsson and HåkanJohansson, London: Routledge, 2025. 166 pp. $160.00 (hardcover) ISBN: 978‐1‐03‐233194‐2
Does Size Matter for the Relationship Between Politics and Administration?
papers.abstract: Owing to public administrations' expansion of their roles in policy design and coordination, concerns about bureaucratic power have reemerged across democratic systems. However, little is known concerning how elected politicians experience and interpret administrative influence, particularly in local governments, in which administrative capacity often rivals political authority. This study examined how local politicians perceive administrative influence and how these perceptions vary across organizational scales and party affiliations. Using survey data from Norwegian municipal politicians, this study found that administrative influence is perceived as a normal, bounded aspect of governance, rather than bureaucratic domination. However, perceptions vary systematically by municipal size; politicians in larger municipalities report stronger administrative influence, reflecting greater specialization and delegation. These perceptions were further conditioned by political interpretations. Elite skeptical representatives evaluated administrative influence more negatively, particularly in larger jurisdictions, demonstrating how administrative power is institutionally structured and politically interpreted, offering insights relevant to governance systems globally.
papers.abstract_zh: 由於公共行政機關在政策設計與協調方面角色擴張，對於官僚權力的擔憂在各民主體制中再次浮現。然而，對於民選政治人物如何體驗與詮釋行政影響力，卻鮮少有研究探討，特別是在行政能力往往與政治權威不相上下的地方政府中。本研究檢視了地方政治人物如何感知行政影響力，以及這些感知如何因組織規模與政黨歸屬而異。本研究利用挪威市鎮政治人物的問卷調查資料，發現行政影響力被視為治理中正常且有限的一環，而非官僚宰制。然而，這些感知會因市鎮規模而系統性地變化；較大市鎮的政治人物回報更強的行政影響力，這反映了更高的專業化與授權程度。這些感知進一步受到政治詮釋的制約。疑菁英論的代表對行政影響力評價更為負面，特別是在較大的管轄區內，這顯示了行政權力是如何在制度上被建構並在政治上被詮釋的，為全球治理體系提供了相關見解。

papers.title: Interagency collaboration, broker organization, and bureaucratic responsiveness: how public agencies fix complex citizen requests on digital government platforms?
papers.abstract: The widespread adoption of digital platforms has led to a surge in citizen requests. Although inter-agency collaboration is viewed as a crucial mechanism for resolving complex citizen requests, our understanding of its effectiveness remains limited. This study examines how inter-agency collaboration influences bureaucratic responsiveness in resolving complex requests on digital government platforms in China. The findings reveal that inter-agency collaboration significantly reduces resolution rates, a phenomenon known as ‘collaborative failure’. This failure stems from motivational barriers related to responsibility reluctance, risk aversion, and hierarchical sensitivity, wherein broker organizations with higher political authority can mitigate such barriers.
papers.abstract_zh: 數位平臺的普及，使得公民請求大量湧現。儘管跨機關協作被視為解決複雜公民請求的關鍵機制，但我們對其有效性的理解仍相當有限。本研究旨在探討跨機關協作如何影響中國數位政府平臺上，複雜請求解決過程中的官僚回應性。研究結果揭示，跨機關協作顯著降低了請求的解決率，此一現象被稱為「協作失靈」。這種失靈源於與責任規避、風險規避和層級敏感性相關的動機障礙；其中，具有較高政治權威的中介組織能夠有效緩解此類障礙。

papers.title: Regional bombs and public labor obligations
papers.abstract: This study examines the long-term effects of wartime experiences on individual contributions to local public labor obligations, seen as a form of self-provision of public services. Analyzing data from one of the most intensive regional bombing campaigns in history during the Vietnam War and six national census waves, I identify a U-shaped pattern in the causal relationships using an instrumental variable (IV). These findings indicate that individuals with wartime exposure initially contribute less to public labor obligations. Their contributions increase when they endure high-intensity regional bombings. This pattern is particularly evident in Northern Vietnam, rural regions, and among people born before 1975. The findings make a novel contribution to our understanding of the long-term effects of early-life adversities on public service activities.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討戰爭經驗對個人參與地方公共勞務義務的長期影響，此義務被視為一種公共服務的自主提供形式。透過分析越南戰爭期間歷史上最密集的高強度區域轟炸行動之一的資料，以及六次全國人口普查波次，並運用工具變數 (IV) 方法，本研究發現因果關係呈現U型模式。這些研究結果顯示，具有戰爭暴露經驗的個體起初對公共勞務義務的貢獻較少，但當他們承受高強度區域轟炸時，其貢獻會增加。這種模式在越南北部、農村地區以及1975年前出生的人群中尤其顯著。這些發現對我們理解早期生活逆境對公共服務活動的長期影響，提供了新穎的貢獻。

papers.title: Playing with time: data manipulation within the performance evaluation cycle
papers.abstract: Understanding why public organizations manipulate performance data has become an essential theme in public administration scholarship. While prior research has extensively explored the individual and contextual drivers of gaming, the temporal dimension—specifically when manipulation occurs—remains remarkably underexplored. Moving beyond the impact of sporadic political events, this study examines the routine, institutionalized rhythms of the bureaucratic calendar. Utilizing satellite nighttime light data as an objective benchmark to detect distortion in officially reported GDP across 271 Chinese cities (2013–2020), we uncover a systematic, cyclical pattern of strategic gaming. Manipulation is substantial in the first quarter, consistent with political pressure for a “good start,” recedes during the middle of the year; and surges to its annual peak in the fourth quarter (Q4) as the final performance assessment looms. Furthermore, we show that this Q4 effect is contingent on local context: cities with lower fiscal autonomy and reduced marketization exhibit a significantly greater propensity to inflate year-end figures. By uncovering a routine form of manipulation embedded in bureaucratic practices, our study advances theories of performance gaming and sheds light on the strategic use of time in public management.
papers.journal: Journal of Public Administration Research and Theory
papers.abstract_zh: 探討公共組織為何操弄績效數據，已成為公共行政學術研究中的一個重要課題。儘管既有研究已廣泛探討績效操弄的個體與情境驅動因素，但時間面向——特別是操弄發生的時機——仍顯著地缺乏探討。本研究超越偶發性政治事件的影響，轉而檢視官僚體制運作時程中例行性、制度化的規律。本研究採用衛星夜間燈光資料作為客觀衡量基準，以檢測271個中國城市 (2013-2020年) 官方公布國內生產毛額(GDP)數據中的失真，從而揭示了策略性績效操弄的系統性、循環性模式。操弄在第一季顯著，符合追求「開門紅」的政治壓力；在年中趨緩；並隨著最終績效考核的逼近，在第四季 (Q4) 達到年度高峰。此外，本研究亦指出，此第四季效應取決於地方脈絡：財政自主性較低且市場化程度較低的城市，展現出顯著更高的虛報年終數據傾向。透過揭露一種根植於官僚實務的例行性操弄形式，本研究不僅推進了績效操弄的相關理論，也闡明了公共管理中時間的策略性運用方式。

papers.title: The voice of the voiceless: refugees’ perceptions of participation under constraint
papers.abstract: Refugee camps have evolved into durable governance sites characterized by centralized authority and monopolistic service environments where residents lack “exit” options. While public administration scholarship extensively theorizes the benefits of participation, research often assumes a baseline of stable, democratic institutions, leaving “participation under constraint” underdeveloped. This study examines whether “thin” participation—awareness of feedback mechanisms and consultative outreach—is associated with refugees’ perceived outcomes at individual, community, and institutional levels. Using household-level survey data from 876 households across thirty-three refugee sites in Cox’s Bazar, Bangladesh, we find that both latent awareness and consultation are significantly associated with improved subjective well-being. Our findings reveal a tiered impact: passive awareness correlates with community and institutional gains, while the relational intensity of consultation is required for individual-level improvements. These results suggest that even minimal engagement functions as a vital generative mechanism for institutional legitimacy in high-dependency, non-democratic environments.
papers.journal: Journal of Public Administration Research and Theory
papers.abstract_zh: 難民營已演變為持久的治理場域，其特徵為集中式權威和壟斷性服務環境，在此居民缺乏「退出」選項。儘管公共行政學術界廣泛地探討參與的益處，研究卻常假設穩定的民主制度為基礎，使得「受限下的參與」發展不足。本研究探討「薄弱」參與—即對回饋機制和諮詢外展的認知—是否與難民在個人、社群和機構層面的感知結果相關。本研究利用來自孟加拉國科克斯巴扎爾33個難民營的876個家戶層級調查資料，發現潛在認知和諮詢都顯著地與改善的主觀幸福感相關。我們的研究結果揭示了分層的影響：被動認知與社群和機構層面的獲益相關，而諮詢的關係強度則是個人層面改善所必需的。這些結果表明，即使是最低限度的參與，也能作為一個重要的生成機制，促進高度依賴、非民主環境中的機構合法性。

papers.title: Resolving Agile Ambidexterity: Between Ambivalence, Adaptation, and Accommodation
papers.abstract: Public bureaucracies address challenging and complex problems by applying agile work practices when standard operating procedures or routines fail. In these situations, public managers need to decide whether to exploit existing bureaucratic routines or explore novel solutions through non‐routine agile work practices. This study shows how public managers maneuver between different adoption decisions: (1) remain ambivalent and reject agile, (2) accommodate the needs of the bureaucracy and adjust agile work practices to align with administrative routines, or (3) adapt in an ambidextrous manner by becoming agile literate and choosing the appropriate work practices depending on the public management problem. This study contributes to the literature on agile governance by incorporating the notion of ambidexterity into the existing theory of 21st‐century bureaucracy.
papers.abstract_zh: 當標準作業程序或例行公事失效時，公部門科層體制會透過應用敏捷工作實務來處理具挑戰性且複雜的問題。在這些情況下，公部門管理者需要決定是利用現有的科層體制例行公事，還是透過非例行性的敏捷工作實務來探索新穎的解決方案。本研究闡述了公部門管理者如何在不同的採用決策之間權衡：(1) 保持矛盾並拒絕敏捷；(2) 順應科層體制的需求，並調整敏捷工作實務以符合行政例行公事；或 (3) 透過成為敏捷素養者，並根據公共管理問題選擇適當的工作實務，以雙元方式進行調適。本研究透過將雙元性概念納入現有的21世紀科層體制理論中，為敏捷治理的文獻做出貢獻。

papers.title: The cognitive fabric of collaborative governance: paradox mindset in transformation-oriented collaborations
papers.abstract: This theoretical article develops a micro-foundational perspective on how and under what conditions collaborative governance groups generate transformative outcomes. It integrates literature on collaboration, transformation, and paradox to advance three core propositions. First, collaborating for transformative outcomes constitutes a distinctive paradoxical context, in which the tensions of collaboration and the tensions of transformation are nested, reinforcing, and constitutive of the process itself. Second, diversity in collaborators’ cognitive-emotional capacity to perceive and navigate tensions (i.e. paradox mindset) shapes collaborative outcomes, with diversity in paradox mindset enhancing the likelihood of transformative outcomes. Third, the paradoxical leadership behaviours of designated leaders further increase the likelihood of transformative outcomes. By highlighting the dual challenge of transformation-oriented collaborations of eliciting tensions to stimulate change while containing them to sustain collaboration, the article links individual-level cognitive-emotional predisposition to group dynamics and system-level outcomes, offering a broader theorizing of collaborations in public administration.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文提出一個微觀基礎觀點，探討協作治理群體如何以及在何種條件下產生轉型性成果。本文整合了協作、轉型與弔詭相關文獻，旨在提出三個核心命題。首先，為達成轉型性成果的協作構成一個獨特的弔詭脈絡，其中協作張力與轉型張力相互鑲嵌、相互強化，並為該過程的本質構成要素。其次，協作者感知與駕馭張力的認知情感能力（亦即弔詭心態）之多樣性，形塑了協作成果，其中弔詭心態的多樣性將提高轉型性成果的產生機率。第三，指定領導者的弔詭式領導行為，將進一步提高轉型性成果的產生機率。藉由突顯轉型導向協作的雙重挑戰——亦即激發張力以刺激變革，同時加以控制以維持協作——本文將個體層次的認知情感傾向與群體動態及系統層次成果連結起來，為公共行政領域的協作提供更廣泛的理論建構。

papers.title: The Matthew Effect in American Generosity? Philanthropic Disparities and the Role of Government Support
papers.abstract: This study examines how economic, racial, and ecological dimensions of community disadvantage shape philanthropic donations to local human services nonprofit sectors, and whether government support mitigates these place‐based disparities. Using a novel county‐level panel dataset spanning 2000–2019, we combine descriptive analyses with mixed‐effects regression models to estimate both direct and moderating relationships. We find that per capita private donations are significantly lower in economically deprived communities and significantly higher in rural communities, while minority prominence shows no statistically significant association with private giving. While government funding crowds in private donations overall, its moderating role is context specific. Government support does not attenuate philanthropic disparities linked to economic deprivation or minority prominence, but it crowds in private donations more strongly in rural counties than in urban counties. These findings highlight the contingent role of government support and underscore the need for targeted policy strategies to address philanthropic disparities across communities.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究探討社區劣勢的經濟、種族和生態面向如何影響流向當地人類服務非營利部門的慈善捐款，以及政府支持是否能緩解這些地方性差異。本研究利用一份涵蓋2000年至2019年的創新縣級追蹤資料集，結合敘述性分析與混合效果迴歸模型，以估計直接與調節關係。我們發現，人均私人捐款在經濟匱乏社區中顯著較低，在鄉村社區中則顯著較高，而少數族裔集中度與私人捐款之間並無統計上的顯著關聯。儘管政府資金整體而言會引導私人捐款，但其調節作用具有情境特定性。政府支持並未減輕與經濟匱乏或少數族裔集中度相關的慈善捐款差異，但在鄉村縣市比在都市縣市更能強力引導私人捐款。這些發現突顯了政府支持的權變角色，並強調了制定有針對性的政策策略之必要性，以解決跨社區的慈善捐款差異。

papers.title: Conditional Compliance: The Role of Sector and Policy Design in State Sexual Misconduct Policy
papers.abstract: The role of principal-agent dynamics in performance and accountability reforms has been a recurring theme in public administration research. Yet, less attention has been dedicated to how the intersection of sector and policy design shapes principal-agent dynamics and subsequent policy outcomes. This study theoretically explores and empirically tests how sector and policy design shape the effects of state legislation that seeks to prevent shirking (mismanagement and underreporting) in the context of sexual misconduct outcomes in U.S. colleges and universities. We code every state policy designed to regulate higher education institutions’ management of sexual misconduct from 2007 to 2018 in the U.S. and leverage a Poisson Pseudo-Maximum Likelihood with a staggered difference-in-differences design to identify the effects. Our findings suggest that both sector and policy design matter: public institutions increase reporting in response to prevention policies that promote education and awareness, but prevention policies have no effect on private institutions. Other policies regulating enforcement and infrastructure produce null effects across both sectors. These findings have important implications for principal-agent theory and policy design research on effective methods for reducing shirking in social equity, accountability, and performance reporting.
papers.journal: Journal of Public Administration Research and Theory
papers.abstract_zh: 委託人-代理人動態在績效與課責改革中的作用，一直是公共行政研究中反覆出現的主題。然而，對於部門與政策設計的交織如何塑造委託人-代理人動態及後續政策結果，卻較少有研究探討。本研究從理論上探討並實證檢驗部門與政策設計如何影響旨在防止美國大專院校性不當行為結果中怠忽職守（管理不善與低報）的州立法效果。我們編碼了2007年至2018年間美國所有旨在規範高等教育機構性不當行為管理的州政策，並利用卜瓦松偽最大概似法結合交錯式雙重差分設計來識別其效果。我們的研究結果表明，部門與政策設計均有影響：公立機構因應促進教育與意識的預防政策而增加了報告數量，但預防政策對私立機構沒有影響。其他規範執法與基礎設施的政策，對兩個部門而言均產生無效結果。這些發現對於委託人-代理人理論以及關於社會公平、課責與績效報告中減少怠忽職守之有效方法的政策設計研究，具有重要啟示。

papers.title: Governing Before the State: Indigenous Javanese Administrative Theory
papers.abstract: Public administration scholarship often treats the Weberian ideal type as a universal model of bureaucracy, making governance arrangements that differ from it appear deficient rather than different. A decolonizing approach instead asks whether non‐Western historical records can offer alternative ways of theorizing governance. This study explores that possibility through the Nagarakretagama, a 14th‐century Javanese court eulogy composed by Mpu Prapanca in 1365, which predates Machiavelli's The Prince by 148 years. Qualitative content analysis of all 98 cantos identifies five governance domains: bureaucratic hierarchy, mandala‐based territorial administration, conditional fiscal exemptions, a legal order combining written law and custom, and ceremonial practices integrated with administration. These dimensions show how the Javanese empire organized authority, territory, revenue, law, and legitimacy through institutional arrangements that differ from the Weberian model. Reading this governance system as theory reveals an alternative conceptualization of administration and advances a decolonizing, pluriversal approach to public administration.
papers.abstract_zh: 公共行政學術界常將韋伯式理想型視為普遍的官僚體制模型，使得與其不同的治理安排顯得不足而非差異。去殖民化取徑反而探問非西方歷史文獻能否提供另類的治理理論化方式。本研究透過《國家書》（Nagarakretagama）探討此可能性，該書是普拉潘查（Mpu Prapanca）於1365年撰寫的十四世紀爪哇宮廷頌歌，比馬基維利的《君主論》早148年。對全部98首頌歌進行質性內容分析，識別出五個治理領域：官僚層級體系、曼荼羅式領土行政、有條件的財政豁免、結合成文法與習慣法的法律秩序，以及融入行政的儀式性實踐。這些面向展現了爪哇帝國如何透過不同於韋伯模型的制度安排，組織其權威、領土、稅收、法律和合法性。將此治理體系視為理論，揭示了行政的另類概念化，並推進了公共行政的去殖民化、多元宇宙取徑。

papers.title: Awareness, Costs, and Take-up of Social Benefits: Evidence from a Field Experiment in China
papers.abstract: This study examines incomplete participation in social benefit programs by focusing on individual income tax refund claims in China. Despite growing evidence on this issue, there remains a need to directly compare the effectiveness of addressing behavioral barriers versus alleviating administrative burdens in promoting program take-up. Moreover, when administrative burdens are targeted, it is unclear whether reducing learning, compliance, or psychological costs is most effective. To address these questions, we investigate how policy interventions designed to enhance program awareness and reduce participation costs affect individuals’ tax refund take-up. In collaboration with a local taxation bureau in China, we conducted a randomized field experiment involving approximately 23,000 eligible taxpayers assigned to different intervention groups. Using administrative data, we tracked their tax refund filing activities during the settlement period. Results show that awareness-enhancing interventions increased take-up by 2.19 percentage points, whereas cost-reduction efforts yielded limited or unintended negative effects.
papers.journal: Journal of Public Administration Research and Theory
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究透過聚焦於中國的個人所得稅退稅申報，探討社會福利計畫中參與不完全的問題。儘管關於此議題的證據日益增多，但仍有必要直接比較解決行為障礙與減輕行政負擔在促進計畫參與率方面的有效性。此外，當針對行政負擔進行干預時，尚不清楚降低學習成本、遵循成本或心理成本何者最為有效。為了解決這些問題，我們探討旨在提高計畫認知度並降低參與成本的政策干預措施，如何影響個人的退稅參與率。我們與中國的一個地方稅務局合作，進行了一項隨機實地實驗，涉及約23,000名符合資格的納稅人，他們被分配到不同的干預組。運用行政資料，我們追蹤了他們在結算期間的退稅申報活動。結果顯示，提高認知度的干預措施使參與率增加了2.19個百分點，而降低成本的努力則產生了有限或意想不到的負面影響。

papers.title: Paradoxical tensions as catalysts: a phenomenon-based study of employee-driven innovation in the civil service
papers.abstract: The paradox of innovation in civil service contexts lies in the simultaneous need for both innovation and risk avoidance within government operations. Our qualitative study, involving 125 Irish civil servants, explores employee-driven innovation (EDI) through a paradox lens to unveil four continua of opposing forces: stability vs. change; bureaucracy vs. flexibility; hierarchical control vs. individual empowerment; and siloization vs. integration. We evidence how managers act as agents to reconcile these tensions to facilitate employee-driven innovation, thus rendering tensions as catalysts for innovation rather than mere contextual factors. We discuss the implications for both theory and practice of EDI.
papers.abstract_zh: 公務體系中的創新悖論在於政府運作同時需要創新與規避風險。我們的質性研究針對125位愛爾蘭公務員進行，透過悖論視角探討員工驅動式創新（EDI），揭示了四個對立力量的連續體：穩定性與變革、官僚體制與彈性、層級控制與個人賦權，以及筒倉化與整合。我們闡明了管理者如何作為促成者來化解這些張力，以促進員工驅動式創新，從而使這些張力成為創新的催化劑，而非僅僅是情境因素。我們討論了本研究對於員工驅動式創新（EDI）在理論與實務上的意涵。

papers.title: When Markets and Democracy Coincide: Perceived Sector Differences in Participation in Government-Funded Programs
papers.abstract: This article investigates the effects of participation on performance assessment in government, for-profit, and nonprofit organizations that deliver public services. In addition to examining the impact of participation on public assessments of performance, we also test the perceived tradeoff between efficiency and participation, as well as the sectoral differences in the participation-performance relationship. We conducted a preregistered vignette experiment using the context of US nursing homes where various organizational information, including participation opportunities, and sector of operation (public, for-profit, and nonprofit sectors) serve as key treatment manipulations. We find that participation plays a critical role in enhancing perceptions of organizations regardless of sectors, but government organizations may obtain greater benefits by pursuing participation, especially in improving public perception of bureaucratic effectiveness and efficiency. These findings suggest that participation is not only normatively desirable, but also practically beneficial for organizations. The findings from this study contribute to advancing our knowledge on public participation, sector differences, performance management, and public values. Clinical Trial Registration This research was pre-registered at the American Economic Association's registry for randomized controlled trials (RCT ID: AEARCTR-0011918 and URL hidden for peer review).
papers.journal: The American Review of Public Administration
papers.abstract_zh:
本文探討參與對提供公共服務之政府、營利與非營利組織績效評估的影響。除了檢視參與對公眾績效評估的影響外，我們亦檢驗效率與參與之間感知的權衡取捨，以及參與-績效關係中的部門差異。我們進行了一項預先註冊的情境實驗，以美國安養院為背景，其中各種組織資訊（包括參與機會）以及營運部門（公共、營利與非營利部門）作為主要的處理操作。我們發現，參與在提升組織觀感方面扮演關鍵角色，不論部門為何；但政府組織透過追求參與可能獲得更大的效益，特別是在改善公眾對官僚效能與效率的認知方面。這些發現表明，參與不僅在規範上是可取的，而且對組織而言也具有實際效益。本研究的發現有助於增進我們對公眾參與、部門差異、績效管理以及公共價值的知識。

臨床試驗註冊：本研究已在美國經濟學會的隨機對照試驗註冊處預先註冊（隨機對照試驗編號：AEARCTR-0011918，網址為同儕審查目的而隱藏）。

papers.title: Putting Democratic Theory and Principles of Justice in the Right Place: Ethical Pluralism in Collaborative and Participatory Governance
papers.abstract: Participatory and collaborative governance (P&CG) is widely celebrated as an institutional vehicle for democratizing public decision‐making by inviting affected stakeholders into inclusive and deliberative policy processes. This essay argues that underlying appeals to democratic legitimacy in P&CG are tacit commitments to specific (and often ideologically bounded) conceptions of justice. Democracy, far from being normatively univocal, encompasses competing justice principles that yield divergent and sometimes incompatible design imperatives. In response, this essay calls for a shift from vague democratic invocations to a more precise theorization of justice as the operative normative currency in P&CG. To this end, the essay outlines an analytical framework that maps three core dimensions of governance design (input, process, and output) onto corresponding domains of justice: representational, procedural, and distributive. Systematically unpacking the plural and conflicting ethical principles within each domain shows how different principles of justice produce distinct governance dilemmas and trade‐offs.
papers.abstract_zh: 參與式與協作式治理 (P&CG) 廣受肯定，被視為一種制度載體，透過邀請受影響的利害關係人參與具包容性與審議性的政策過程，以實現公共決策的民主化。本文主張，P&CG 中對民主正當性的潛在訴求，實質上隱含著對特定（且常受意識形態限制）正義觀的承諾。民主在規範上絕非單一，它涵蓋相互競爭的正義原則，這些原則導致分歧且有時相互衝突的設計準則。有鑑於此，本文呼籲從籠統的民主論述轉向對正義更精確的理論化，將其視為 P&CG 中實際運作的核心規範依據。為達此目的，本文概述了一個分析框架，將治理設計的三個核心維度（投入、過程和產出）對應到相應的正義領域：代表性正義、程序性正義和分配性正義。系統性地剖析每個領域內多元且相互衝突的倫理原則，揭示了不同的正義原則如何產生獨特的治理困境與權衡取捨。

papers.title: Selection Method, Partisanship, and Performance of Government Oversight Functions
papers.abstract: This study examines how the selection of public sector leaders affects organizational outcomes, especially in oversight functions where independence is expected. Political economy literature suggests that elected leaders better respond to voter preferences, while appointed leaders possess more expertise. Drawing on public administration theories of political control of the bureaucracy, we posit that, regardless of the selection method, public sector leaders as agents are subject to the influence of political principals with authority over the selection process. When the principal's interest is not aligned with the public interest, as seen in government oversight functions, its influence could compromise the performance of the selected leaders. Focusing on state auditors, the study finds that on average, selection methods are not correlated with audit findings, but an auditor whose political principal shares the same party affiliation as the auditee (the state governor) is less likely to identify financial management deficiencies.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究探討公部門領導者之選任方式如何影響組織績效，尤其是在預期應具獨立性的監督職能中。政治經濟學文獻指出，經選舉產生的領導者更能回應選民偏好，而經任命的領導者則擁有更多專業知識。借鑒公共行政學中關於官僚體系政治控制的理論，本研究主張，無論選任方式為何，公部門領導者作為代理人，均受掌握選任過程權力的政治委託人影響。當委託人的利益與公共利益不一致時，尤其是在政府監督職能中，其影響可能損害被選任領導者的績效。本研究以州審計官為研究對象，發現平均而言，選任方式與審計結果並無關聯，但若審計官的政治委託人與受審計者（州長）具有相同政黨歸屬，則較不可能發現財務管理上的缺失。

papers.title: Rethinking Local Choice: Experimental Evidence on Taxpayer Sentiment and Public School Funding
papers.abstract: Taxpayers often have conflicting views on what constitutes fair taxation and how tax revenues should be allocated. We work with Vermont legislators on the policy concern of sentiment in a property tax setting, given the Vermont Supreme Court ruling around the principle of educational equality. To explore tax sentiment in a complex and highly regulated environment, we use a behavioral public administration approach for our experiment. Our findings are threefold: (1) we identify four central themes of taxpayer sentiment regarding property taxes: fairness and equity, transparency and accountability, responsible use of public funds, and the burden on vulnerable populations; (2) we demonstrate that taxpayer sentiment and agency are significantly shaped by how property tax revenue is allocated; and (3) we show how practitioner‐academic collaborations can address the tensions inherent in tax policy design.
papers.abstract_zh: 納稅人對於公平稅制及稅收分配方式常有意見分歧。鑑於佛蒙特州最高法院針對教育平等原則的裁定，我們與該州立法委員合作，探討不動產稅制下民眾觀點的政策議題。為探討複雜且高度管制的環境中的稅務民意，我們採用行為公共行政方法進行實驗。本研究發現有三：(1) 我們歸納出納稅人對於不動產稅的四個核心觀點主題：公平性與衡平性、透明度與問責性、公共經費的妥善運用，以及弱勢族群的負擔；(2) 我們證明納稅人觀點與主體性受到不動產稅收分配方式的顯著影響；(3) 我們說明實務界與學術界的合作如何能解決稅務政策設計中固有的張力。

papers.title: Beyond the hassle: how favorable outcomes reduce the subjective experience of administrative burden
papers.abstract: A large body of research shows that compliance demands—administrative hassles and rules—impose learning, compliance, and psychological costs on individuals. Because costs are conceptualized as subjective, most studies rely on self-reported measures. This article examines that approach by asking: To what extent do factors beyond compliance demands shape the subjective experience of administrative burdens? We argue that one factor, distinct from compliance demands, is the favorability of outcomes allocated by public organizations. We integrate outcome favorability into the administrative burden framework, proposing that (1) favorable outcomes reduce administrative burdens, as subjectively experienced and (2) favorable outcomes moderate the effect of compliance demands on the experience of administrative burdens. We test these expectations in two studies: an analysis of real-world interactions from the German Life Events Survey (n ≈ 4,000) and a Danish survey experiment with randomized demands and outcomes (n = 1,624). Both studies show that favorable outcomes reduce administrative burdens, as subjectively experienced, raising questions about how much self-reported learning, compliance, and psychological costs reflect reactions to administrative requirements rather than other aspects of citizen-state interactions.
papers.abstract_zh: 大量研究顯示，遵循要求（行政繁瑣與規範）會對個人造成學習、遵循與心理成本。由於成本被概念化為主觀的，大多數研究仰賴自我報告測量。本文透過提問「除了遵循要求之外的因素在多大程度上形塑行政負擔的主觀經驗？」來檢視該方法。我們主張，一個不同於遵循要求的因素，是由公共組織所分配結果的有利性。我們將結果有利性整合到行政負擔框架中，提出 (1) 有利結果會減少主觀感受到的行政負擔，以及 (2) 有利結果會調節遵循要求對行政負擔經驗的影響。我們在兩項研究中檢驗這些預期：一項是對德國生活事件調查（n ≈ 4,000）中真實世界互動的分析，以及一項採用隨機化要求與結果的丹麥調查實驗（n = 1,624）。兩項研究均顯示，有利結果會減少主觀感受到的行政負擔，這引發了關於自我報告的學習、遵循和心理成本在多大程度上反映了對行政要求的反應，而不是公民與國家互動的其他方面的問題。

papers.title: Consolidating Liberal Democracy From Within A Theory of Public Institutional Leadership
papers.abstract: Recent developments in also established democracies have made clear that public administration and management research alike have neglected giving scholarly attention to public organizations as institutions. Drawing upon research on leadership of institutions and leadership in public organizations we suggest a theory of public institutional leadership . Public institutional leadership reconnects public management with democracy by suggesting three central dimensions of leadership behaviors that instill and sustain liberal democratic values in public organizations. These behaviors include articulating and reaffirming democratic values through top‐down vision‐setting; building “character” bottom‐up through role modeling and fostering psychological safety to enable dialogue and deliberation around these values as well as demonstrating constrained responsiveness to political principals relative to those values enabled by the cultivation of bureaucratic autonomy. Although the necessity of such behaviors is made salient by rising populism and democratic backsliding, their relevance extends to public management situated in liberal democracies in general.
papers.abstract_zh: 既有民主國家近來的發展清楚表明，公共行政與管理研究皆忽略了對作為制度的公共組織進行學術探討。本文綜合制度領導與公共組織中領導的研究，提出一套公共制度領導理論。公共制度領導藉由提出領導行為的三個核心面向，將公共管理與民主重新連結，這些行為旨在公共組織中灌輸並維繫自由民主價值。這些行為包括：透過由上而下的願景設定，闡明並重申民主價值；透過樹立榜樣並促進心理安全，由下而上地建立「品格」，以促成圍繞這些價值的對話與審議；以及藉由培養官僚自主性，展現相對於這些價值，對政治主事者受限的回應性。儘管這些行為的必要性因民粹主義興起與民主倒退而日益凸顯，但其適用性廣泛擴及自由民主國家中的公共管理。

papers.title: Reference points, negativity bias and citizens’ performance evaluations: a replication and extension
papers.abstract: Experiments on how cognitive biases, such as social and historical reference points and negativity bias, shape citizens’ evaluations of government performance have produced mixed findings, which typically come from Western contexts and focus on single reference points. To address these gaps, we replicated (N = 3710) and extended (N = 2356) Olsen’s ‘Compared to what?’ to interactions between multiple social and historical reference points in Hong Kong. Very low baselines are found in the replication alongside trivial evidence for the importance of reference points in citizens’ performance evaluations and negativity bias. In the extension, we found that (1) when both social and historical reference points are presented to participants, they have stronger effects when negative information is provided and (2) the effects of combinations of historical and social reference points differ across policy domains. Though survey experiments can be noisy, the study demonstrates the value of replication to question the generalization of cognitive biases.
papers.abstract_zh: 關於認知偏誤（例如社會與歷史參考點以及負面偏誤）如何影響公民對政府績效評估的實驗，產生了不一的結果，這些結果通常來自西方脈絡，且側重於單一參考點。為了解決這些不足，我們在香港複製（N = 3710）並擴展（N = 2356）了Olsen的「與什麼相比？」研究，以探討多個社會與歷史參考點之間的交互作用。在複製研究中發現了非常低的基準線，同時，關於參考點在公民績效評估和負面偏誤中的重要性，僅發現了微不足道的證據。在擴展研究中，我們發現 (1) 當同時向參與者呈現社會與歷史參考點時，若提供負面資訊，其影響會更強；以及 (2) 歷史與社會參考點組合的影響在不同政策領域中有所差異。儘管問卷實驗可能存在雜訊，本研究證明了複製研究的價值，以質疑認知偏誤的普遍性。

papers.title: To Add Insult to Injury: Exploring the Impact of Policy Inequity on Administrative Burden
papers.abstract: The relationship between inequity and administrative burden constitutes a pivotal concern in the realm of public administration and policy, but how policy inequity (i.e., inequity in policy implementation) influences administrative burden has garnered scant attention. The present study employs data about public assistance programs in China spanning from 2015 to 2017 to examine the consequences of policy inequity on administrative burden. The empirical findings underscore that policy inequity augments psychological and compliance costs while concurrently diminishing citizens' participation in welfare programs, thereby indicating that policy inequity intensifies administrative burden. Notably, individual‐level social capital and contextual‐level information transparency in terms of public exposure related to welfare approval and receipt significantly moderate this relationship. Contrary to our theoretical expectations, social capital and public exposure amplify, rather than dampen, the impact of policy inequity on administrative burden. This study highlights the policy inequity lens and offers important implications for burden reduction.
papers.abstract_zh: 不平等與行政負擔之間的關係在公共行政與政策領域中構成一個關鍵議題，但政策不平等（亦即政策執行中的不平等）如何影響行政負擔卻鮮少受到關注。本研究採用中國2015年至2017年公共援助計畫的資料，旨在檢視政策不平等對行政負擔的影響。實證結果顯示，政策不平等增加了心理成本與順從成本，同時降低了公民參與福利計畫的程度，藉此指出政策不平等加劇了行政負擔。值得注意的是，個體層次的社會資本以及情境層次上，在福利核准與領取相關的公開揭露方面的資訊透明度，顯著調節了此關係。與我們的理論預期相反，社會資本與公開揭露放大了而非減弱了政策不平等對行政負擔的影響。本研究強調了政策不平等的視角，並為減輕負擔提供了重要的啟示。

papers.title: Informal Authority, Legitimacy Transition, and Institutional Change: A Theory of Advisory Capture
papers.abstract: How do informal actors achieve rapid bureaucratic dismantlement without formal authority? Analyzing the Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE) initiative, this article argues that when performance‐based legitimacy displaces procedural legitimacy as the dominant evaluative framework, informal actors can bypass established safeguards and reshape government institutions. Three concepts capture this process: advisory capture , legitimacy regime transition , and constrained coercion . The analysis reveals that dismantlement targets agencies based on political vulnerability rather than functional logic, that informal authority becomes institutionalized through formal rulemaking such as the Schedule Policy/Career rule, and that judicial review operates as ongoing contestation rather than definitive constraint. Protecting democratic governance requires defending not only formal rules but the legitimacy regimes within which those rules derive meaning.
papers.abstract_zh: 非正式行動者如何在缺乏正式權力下，快速拆解官僚體系？本文透過分析政府效率部（DOGE）的倡議，主張當績效導向合法性取代程序合法性，成為主導的評估框架時，非正式行動者便能規避既定保障措施，並重塑政府機構。三個概念捕捉了此一過程：諮詢俘獲、合法性體制轉型，以及受限脅迫。分析顯示，解構的目標機構是基於政治脆弱性而非功能邏輯；非正式權力透過正式法規制定（例如「職務表政策/職業規則」）而制度化；且司法審查是持續的爭議而非決定性的限制。保護民主治理不僅需要捍衛正式規則，更要捍衛這些規則賴以獲得意義的合法性體制。

papers.title: Cultural Theory, Political Ideology, and Burden Tolerance: The Role of Core Beliefs in Shaping Support for Administrative Burdens
papers.abstract: Administrative burdens embedded within many public policies are often politically contentious, such that core values and belief systems can drive either support or opposition. In this paper, we use survey data from US respondents to replicate and extend previous research on the public acceptance of administrative burdens in general. First, we confirm the measure's validity by examining its effects on beliefs across policies that range from highly polarized to less politically contentious. Second, we test the relationship between tolerance of administrative burden and cultural theory (CT) variables that tap into worldview orientations related to hierarchy, egalitarianism, individualism, and fatalism, which previous research has found predictive of policy preferences across a wide range of domains, even after accounting for political ideology and partisanship. We hypothesize that egalitarians and individualists will generally be less tolerant of burdens, while hierarchs will be more accepting of burdensome requirements. However, this effect varies depending on the nature of the burdens and how they relate to perceived threats for each worldview.
papers.journal: The American Review of Public Administration
papers.abstract_zh: 內嵌於許多公共政策中的行政負擔，往往具有政治爭議性，核心價值觀和信仰體系可能驅動人們對其支持或反對。本文利用美國受訪者的調查數據，旨在複製並拓展先前關於公眾對行政負擔普遍接受度的研究。首先，我們透過檢視該衡量指標對橫跨從高度兩極化到較少政治爭議性政策之信念的影響，以確認其效度。其次，我們檢驗行政負擔容忍度與文化理論 (CT) 變項之間的關係，這些變項探討了與層級、平等主義、個人主義和宿命論相關的世界觀取向，先前研究發現這些變項即使在考量了政治意識形態和黨派歸屬之後，仍可預測廣泛領域的政策偏好。我們假設平等主義者和個人主義者通常對負擔的容忍度較低，而層級主義者則較能接受繁瑣的要求。然而，這種影響會因負擔的性質以及它們如何與不同世界觀所感知到的威脅相關而異。

papers.title: Disparity in Police Disciplinary Outcomes: The Mediating Effect of Complaint Disposition for Organizational Outgroups
papers.abstract: In response to demands for greater police accountability, many departments have adopted policies designed to better regulate the use of force and to make it easier to investigate and punish officers accused of wrongdoing. While not widespread, there is some evidence that these changes have increased disciplinary actions. However, it remains uncertain whether police discipline has been applied equitably across racial and gender groups within departments. Drawing on multiple bodies of scholarship, we develop the expectation that, because of their status as members of organizational outgroups, Black, Hispanic and female officers are likely to be disciplined at higher rates. Importantly, we also argue that racial, ethnic and gender differences in disciplinary outcomes are at least partially mediated by the way in which police departments treat complaints against these officers. We test these hypotheses in data from Chicago's Civilian Office of Police Accountability (COPA) from 1971 through 2018. Analyses of over 249,000 allegations indicate that female and Black officers and officers face a higher likelihood of reprimand and suspension compared to White male officers. Differences across these groups are entirely explained, however, by the greater likelihood that complaints against these officers are deemed sufficiently supported by evidence to warrant disciplinary action. We conclude by discussing the broader implications for understanding employee discipline and the potential impact of recent efforts to enhance police accountability.
papers.journal: The American Review of Public Administration
papers.abstract_zh: 為回應提升警察問責制的要求，許多警政單位已採行政策，旨在更妥善規範武力使用，並使調查和懲處被指控行為不當的員警更容易。儘管尚未普及，但有證據顯示這些變革已增加了懲戒行動。然而，警察懲戒是否已在各單位內部的不同種族和性別群體之間公平應用，仍不確定。借鑒多個學術領域的研究，我們預期非裔、拉丁裔和女性員警因其作為組織外群體成員的地位，更可能受到較高比例的懲戒。重要的是，我們也主張懲戒結果中的種族、族裔和性別差異，至少部分地由警政單位處理針對這些員警的投訴方式所中介。我們利用芝加哥警察問責平民辦公室（COPA）從1971年至2018年的數據來檢驗這些假設。對超過249,000項指控的分析顯示，相較於白人男性員警，女性和非裔員警面臨較高的訓斥和停職可能性。然而，這些群體之間的差異完全可由針對這些員警的投訴更有可能被認為有足夠證據支持，以致應採取懲戒行動來解釋。最後，我們討論對於理解員工懲戒的更廣泛意涵，以及近期提升警察問責制努力的潛在影響。

papers.title: Chainsaw or scalpel: which leads to more blame for a service failure when leaders downsize government?
papers.abstract: The Trump administration’s DOGE attempted to radically downsize U.S. federal agencies. This study aims to clarify whether government leaders are blamed more for service failure when they employ either a DOGE-like (chainsaw) method or a more measured (scalpel) approach. A preregistered experiment was conducted in which respondents were randomly assigned to one of 6 vignettes that presented information about downsizing approaches, a public service failure, and the person or entity directly responsible for the failure. This study produced four main findings. First, people blamed city leaders more for the service failure when they knew a chainsaw approach was used to downsize government, compared to when they were given no information about the approach. Second, people blamed city leaders more when a chainsaw approach was used than when a scalpel approach was used. Third, simply knowing that city leaders had used a downsizing approach was not enough to shift blame away from the frontline employee toward city leaders. Fourth, blame shifted from the frontline employee to city leaders when people learned that a chainsaw approach—rather than a scalpel approach—had been used. The implications for research and practice are that a chainsaw approach is undesirable.
papers.abstract_zh: 川普政府的DOGE試圖大幅縮編美國聯邦機構。本研究旨在釐清，當政府領導者採用DOGE式（電鋸式）方法或更審慎（手術刀式）方法時，他們是否在服務失靈時受到更多責備。本研究進行了一項預先註冊的實驗，受訪者被隨機分配到六個情境之一，這些情境呈現了關於縮編方法、公共服務失靈以及直接負責失靈的人員或實體之資訊。本研究得出四項主要發現。首先，當人們得知政府採用電鋸式方法進行縮編時，他們對城市領導者在服務失靈上的責備更多，相較於未獲得任何關於該方法資訊的情況。其次，當採用電鋸式方法時，人們對城市領導者的責備更多，相較於採用手術刀式方法。第三，僅僅知道城市領導者曾使用縮編方法，並不足以將責備從第一線員工轉移到城市領導者身上。第四，當人們得知採用的是電鋸式方法而非手術刀式方法時，責備從第一線員工轉移到城市領導者身上。對於研究和實務的啟示是，電鋸式方法是不可取的。

papers.title: Rethinking Budgeting? An Analysis of Budget Theory and Reform for Modernizing Municipal Practice
papers.abstract: This study examines the persistent gap between budget theory and practice in local governments, using the Government Finance Officers Association's (GFOA) Rethinking Budgeting Initiative as a case study. Analyzing 32 GFOA publications from 2020 to 2024, we identify four key themes in the GFOA's attempt to modernize budgetary decision‐making: public values, behavioral science, coordination and collaboration, and fiscal prudence. Through a narrative synthesis grounded in budget theory, we find normative theories align with reforms emphasizing participatory practices and public values, while descriptive theories underpin traditional fiscal approaches. The endurance of incremental budgeting, despite reformist rhetoric, underscores the challenge of transforming budget practice. Our findings suggest meaningful reform depends on integrating behavioral insights, stakeholder collaboration, and value‐driven goals with theoretical frameworks. Ultimately, this study contributes to scholarly discourse by highlighting opportunities to advance budget theory and improve practitioner engagement, offering a pathway for more adaptive and responsive local government budgeting practices.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究探討地方政府預算理論與實務之間持續存在的落差，並以政府財務官員協會 (GFOA) 的「預算重思倡議」作為案例研究。透過分析 GFOA 於 2020 至 2024 年間發布的 32 份出版品，我們歸納出 GFOA 在試圖現代化預算決策時的四個關鍵主題：公共價值、行為科學、協調與合作，以及財政審慎。透過根植於預算理論的敘事綜合分析，我們發現規範性理論與強調參與式實踐和公共價值的改革相符，而描述性理論則支撐著傳統的財政方法。儘管改革言論不斷，漸進式預算編列的持續存在凸顯了轉變預算實務的挑戰。我們的研究結果表明，有意義的改革取決於將行為洞察、利害關係人合作和價值導向目標與理論框架整合。最終，本研究透過突顯推進預算理論和提升實務工作者參與的機會，有助於學術論述，為地方政府預算實務提供一條更具適應性和回應性的途徑。

papers.title: The Politics of Collaborative Public Management: A Primer. By RobertAgranoff and AlexeiKolpakov, New York: Routledge, 2023. 278 pp. $55.99 (hardback). ISBN: 978‐1‐03‐247362‐8
Stimulating Pro‐Environmental Behavior Using Management Control: Survey Evidence From a City Government
papers.abstract: This paper investigates how pro‐environmental behaviors (PEBs) of public sector employees can be stimulated using management control. We mobilize the theory of planned behavior to hypothesize that employee environmental concerns are associated with PEBs, and that this relation can be strengthened by management control instruments that provide structure and signals about prevailing norms. Using survey data from 151 public sector employees, we find support for most of our expectations. Specifically, our findings suggest that sustainability‐related output controls (e.g., sustainable performance budgets and accounting reports) can help employees to translate their environmental concerns into action through PEBs. Furthermore, we find that behavior controls (e.g., formats that incorporate sustainability and resilience‐enhancing action programs) positively associate with PEBs, regardless of employees' initial environmental concerns. Taken together, our findings have implications for public sector organizations seeking to stimulate employees to engage in more environmentally sustainable behaviors.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文探討如何運用管理控制來激勵公部門員工的親環境行為 (PEBs)。本研究援引計畫行為理論，假設員工的環境關懷與親環境行為相關，且此關係可透過提供結構並傳達現行規範的管理控制工具而強化。運用來自151位公部門員工的問卷資料，本研究發現大部分預期獲得支持。具體而言，本研究結果顯示，永續相關的產出控制（例如：永續績效預算和會計報告）能協助員工將其環境關懷透過親環境行為轉化為實際行動。此外，本研究發現，行為控制（例如：納入永續與提升韌性行動方案的格式）與親環境行為呈正相關，無論員工最初的環境關懷程度如何。總體而言，本研究結果對於旨在激勵員工從事更多環境永續行為的公部門組織具有啟示。

papers.title: American Society for Public Administration Code of Ethics
papers.abstract: Approved by the ASPA National Council March 16, 2013, along with Practices for carrying out the Code available at www.aspanet.org/CodeofEthics. In 2014, the Ethics and Standards Implementation Committee was created to advance awareness of ethics in public service, provide advice and assistance to members in handling ethical problems, and review and seek to resolve ethics complaints regarding members who may have violated the Code.
papers.abstract_zh: 本準則經ASPA全國理事會於2013年3月16日核准，其執行規範詳見www.aspanet.org/CodeofEthics。2014年，倫理與標準實施委員會成立，旨在提升公務倫理意識，在處理倫理問題上向會員提供建議與協助，並審查及尋求解決關於可能違反本準則之會員的倫理申訴。

papers.title: Celebrating 85 Years
