The Diffusion of Local Administrative Innovation: Investigating Municipal Climate Managers in the State of Hessen in Central Germany
papers.abstract: Many cities and municipalities aim to address climate change, yet their rigid administrative structures often constrain effective action. Therefore, local authorities must innovate to build administrative capacity and enable work across departmental silos. However, we lack knowledge of how such administrative innovations emerge and become more widespread. To address this gap, this article examines administrative innovation from a diffusion perspective, drawing on a novel theoretical framework of soft diffusion channels. It studies the establishment of climate manager positions across all 426 municipalities in the German state of Hessen between 2008 and 2023. Event history models suggest that the creation of these positions, most with federal grant support, is associated with various diffusion channels, including county‐level policy examples and membership in a state‐run climate network, as well as additional capacity indicators. Thus, the diffusion of local administrative innovation resembles a multi‐channel process that practitioners at different government levels can actively support.
papers.abstract_zh: 許多城市和地方政府旨在應對氣候變遷，然而其僵化的行政結構經常限制了有效的作為。因此，地方政府必須創新以建立行政量能，並促成跨部門協作。然而，我們對於這些行政創新如何產生並擴散缺乏了解。為彌補此一知識鴻溝，本文從擴散觀點檢視行政創新，並借鑒一套關於軟性擴散管道的新穎理論框架。本文研究了2008年至2023年間，德國黑森邦 (Hessen) 所有426個地方政府中氣候經理人職位的設立情況。事件史模型結果顯示，這些職位的設立（其中大多數獲得聯邦補助支持）與多種擴散管道相關，包括郡級政策範例、加入邦營氣候網絡，以及額外的量能指標。因此，地方行政創新的擴散類似於一個多管道的過程，不同層級的政府實務工作者可以積極支持。

papers.title: Organizational strategies for system robustness: how managers navigate the institutional architecture of complex systems
papers.abstract: Many public managers oversee complex systems that require them to navigate multifaceted organizational decision-making processes. While there is general recognition that institutions constrain information processing, rigorous study of how particular institutional designs influence the strategies used by organizations to process information and act on the systems they oversee is limited by existing theory and methodological approaches. We propose a theoretical approach that integrates established understanding of institutions as choice architectures and disproportionate information processing in organizations with new understanding of collective inference from cognitive science. The approach addresses three limitations in existing theory: (1) the relationship between detailed institutional designs and organizational strategies, (2) the role of flexibility in information processing, and (3) the relationship between organizational strategies and system robustness. We demonstrate its application empirically using a mixed methods approach that combines institutional analysis and process tracing with a dynamic model to analyze how the City of Phoenix Water Services Department responded to environmental change through investment and ratemaking actions. Our findings highlight how institutional designs that require managers to account for multiple objectives benefit from added flexibility, allowing managers to explore new approaches that address competing objectives and increase system robustness. Conversely, designs exhibiting high costs without high flexibility may create rigidity traps that hinder action and reduce system robustness in the face of uncertainty.
papers.journal: Journal of Public Administration Research and Theory
papers.abstract_zh: 許多公共管理者負責管理複雜系統，這要求他們駕馭多面向的組織決策流程。儘管普遍認知制度會約束資訊處理，但關於特定制度設計如何影響組織處理資訊並對其所管理系統採取行動的策略，對此的嚴謹研究卻受限於現有理論與方法論途徑。我們提出一種理論途徑，整合了將制度視為選擇架構的既有理解、組織中不成比例的資訊處理，以及認知科學中對集體推論的新理解。此途徑解決了現有理論的三個限制：(一) 詳細制度設計與組織策略之間的關係，(二) 資訊處理中彈性的作用，以及 (三) 組織策略與系統韌性之間的關係。我們以實證方式展示其應用，採用混合方法途徑，結合制度分析與過程追蹤，並搭配動態模型，以分析鳳凰城市水務局如何透過投資和費率制定行動應對環境變化。我們的研究結果強調，要求管理者考量多重目標的制度設計，將受益於額外的彈性，讓管理者得以探索解決相互衝突目標的新方法，並提升系統韌性。相反地，缺乏高度彈性卻伴隨高成本的設計，可能會形成僵化陷阱，阻礙行動，進而降低系統在不確定性下的韌性。

papers.title: Key Practices of Knowledge Mobilization in Local Policy Settings
papers.abstract: The literature on knowledge mobilization (KM) acknowledges the complex processes involved in the application of evidence to policy. However, the everyday activities employed by knowledge mobilizers to facilitate these processes have proved difficult to capture and codify. We address this gap in current understanding through empirical analysis of the practices used to mobilize knowledge in local policy making. We find that effective KM is characterized by relational interactions with diverse actors across research, policy and practice settings; constant and consistent engagement with the local and policy contexts in which evidence is being applied; and the integration of different types of knowledge (including research findings, professional expertise and lived experience) to collectively respond to policy and practice needs. These practices of KM have important implications for how evidence is defined, validated, and used by policymakers and practitioners.
papers.abstract_zh: 知識轉化 (KM) 相關文獻體認到將實證應用於政策所涉及的複雜過程。然而，知識轉化者為促進這些過程所採用的日常實踐，卻難以捕捉與編碼。本研究透過對地方政策制定中知識轉化實踐的實證分析，旨在彌補當前理解上的不足。我們發現，有效的知識轉化具有以下特點：與跨越研究、政策和實務場域的多元行動者進行關係性互動；持續且一致地投入實證應用所處的地方與政策脈絡；以及整合不同類型的知識（包括研究發現、專業知識和生活經驗），以共同回應政策與實務需求。這些知識轉化實踐對於政策制定者與實務工作者如何定義、驗證和使用實證，具有重要意涵。

papers.title: Striking multiple balances in cross-sector collaborations: how leaders navigate institutional complexity with interdependent leadership behaviors
papers.abstract: In cross-sector collaborations, leaders must navigate the complex and often conflicting demands of the public, business, and nonprofit sectors. This study explores how leaders manage this institutional complexity through a multilevel framework, drawing on a case study of a tri-sector partnership developing technology for disaster management. Based on evidence from 27 interviews, observations, and documentary material, we identify the leadership repertoire and, as our core contribution, uncover four distinct types of interdependencies between these behaviors: enabling, substituting, stabilizing, and inhibiting. Our findings reveal that leadership in cross-sector collaborations goes beyond adopting a single style; rather, it requires a strategic orchestration of how different behaviors interact. We identify two overarching strategies (selective targeting and sequential switching) that leaders use to combine complementary behaviors while preventing them from undermining each other. By focusing on leaders’ microlevel agency in response to macrolevel sector differences, this study provides a clearer understanding of how interdependent leadership behaviors converge into what we theorize as institutional leadership in CSCs.
papers.journal: Journal of Public Administration Research and Theory
papers.abstract_zh: 在跨部門合作（CSC）中，領導者必須應對來自公部門、企業部門與非營利部門複雜且常有衝突的需求。本研究透過一個多層次框架，探討領導者如何管理這種制度性複雜性，並借鑒一個旨在開發災害管理技術的三部門夥伴關係個案研究。根據27次訪談、觀察與文獻資料的證據，我們識別出領導者行為庫，並作為我們的核心貢獻，揭示了這些行為之間四種不同類型的相互依存關係：促成、替代、穩定與抑制。我們的研究結果顯示，CSC中的領導力超越了採用單一風格；相反地，它需要策略性地協調不同行為的互動方式。我們識別出兩種總體策略（選擇性目標設定與序列性轉換），領導者用來結合互補行為，同時防止它們相互破壞。透過關注領導者在微觀層面的能動性，以應對宏觀層面的部門差異，本研究提供了更清晰的理解，說明相互依存的領導行為如何匯聚成我們在CSC中理論化的制度性領導力。

papers.title: Tensions Between Client Satisfaction and Employee Motivation in Public Organizations, and Their Reconciliation Through Leadership
papers.abstract: Public organizations widely use client satisfaction feedback to assess their employees, reflecting responsiveness and accountability to policy clients. Yet client satisfaction is inherently subjective and heterogeneous, and it often diverges from mission-relevant performance in ways that can compromise employees’ work motivation. This study conceptualizes this issue as a bottom-up democracy–bureaucracy dilemma and examines the role of leadership in mitigating it. Drawing on experimental evidence (n = 740) and open-ended qualitative responses (13,502 words) from frontline investigators in South Korea's National Police Agency, the study finds that low client (i.e., alleged victims) satisfaction despite high investigatory performance impairs officers’ work motivation. Notably, these demotivating effects are attenuated when the agency head explicitly acknowledges the weak link between performance and satisfaction and avoid treating low satisfaction as direct evidence of poor performance, even as client satisfaction remains a formal evaluative benchmark. This sensegiving approach appears to foster perceptions of interactional fairness, empathy, and understanding, thereby significantly improving officers’ experience ofsatisfaction feedback and their trust in the agency head. A broader implication of this study is that reconciling democratic impulses for policy clients and political stakeholders with administrative imperatives to empower the workforce is a unique challenge for public sector leadership.
papers.journal: The American Review of Public Administration
papers.abstract_zh: 公共組織廣泛運用服務對象滿意度回饋來評估其員工，以反映對政策服務對象的回應性與課責性。然而，服務對象滿意度本質上是主觀且異質的，且常與任務相關績效產生分歧，以致於可能損害員工的工作動機。本研究將此議題概念化為一種由下而上的民主－官僚兩難，並探討領導力在緩解此兩難中的作用。本研究根據來自韓國國家警察廳前線調查員的實驗證據 (n = 740) 以及開放式質性回應 (13,502 字)，發現儘管調查績效高，服務對象（即，聲稱受害者）滿意度低仍損害了警員的工作動機。值得注意的是，當機關首長明確承認績效與滿意度之間的薄弱連結，並避免將低滿意度視為績效不佳的直接證據時，這些去動機化效應會減弱，即使服務對象滿意度仍是正式的評估基準。這種意義賦予方法似乎能促進對互動公平性、同理心和理解的感知，從而顯著改善警員對滿意度回饋的體驗以及他們對機關首長的信任。本研究更廣泛的啟示是，調和對政策服務對象和政治利害關係人的民主衝動，與賦予員工權力的行政要求，是公共部門領導力的一項獨特挑戰。

papers.title: American Administrative Capacity: Decline, Decay, and Resilience By M.Ernita Joaquin and Thomas J.Greitens, Cham, Switzerland: Springer, 2021. 213 pp. $97 (hardcover). ISBN : 978‐3‐030‐80563‐0
The Rise of Midocracy: How NPM and Post‐ NPM Reform Ideas Recombine in Contemporary Public Organizations
papers.abstract: This paper introduces and conceptualizes midocracy as an emergent organizational form in the public sector, characterized by the growth and dominance of a professionalized administrative middle layer. The study argues that midocracy draws on elements associated with both New Public Management (NPM) and post‐NPM reform agendas. While administration is essential for coordination, we show how its unchecked expansion can lead to self‐reinforcing dynamics that distance governance from core operations. Midocracy, we contend, reflects a shift from service delivery to symbolic value signaling, strategic abstraction, and polycentric goal‐setting. Our contribution is both conceptual and diagnostic, offering midocracy as a framework for understanding contemporary administrative expansion and its implications for public sector legitimacy and performance. Finally, we relate and critically examine different explanatory accounts of administrative expansion, highlighting how they interact within the dynamics of midocracy.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文介紹並將「中層行政體制」（midocracy）概念化為公部門一種新興的組織形式，其特點是專業化的行政中介層的成長與主導地位。本研究認為，中層行政體制汲取了與新公共管理（NPM）和後NPM改革議程相關的要素。儘管行政管理對於協調至關重要，但我們指出其不受限制的擴張可能導致自我強化的動態，使治理與核心業務脫節。我們認為，中層行政體制反映了從服務提供轉向象徵性價值傳遞、策略性抽象化以及多中心目標設定的轉變。本研究的貢獻兼具概念性與診斷性，提出中層行政體制作為理解當代行政擴張及其對公部門合法性與績效意涵的分析框架。最後，本文關聯並批判性地審視行政擴張的不同解釋性論述，闡明它們如何在中層行政體制的動態中相互作用。

papers.title: Social Capital and Policy Compliance in a Polarized Democracy: A Necessary Condition Analysis of COVID Vaccination Rates Across US Counties
papers.abstract: Policy compliance, the extent to which citizens adhere to government policies, remains a central test of democratic governance, especially during the COVID‐19 pandemic in the United States. This study examines how distinct forms of social capital—relational, structural (bonding versus bridging), cognitive, and vertical linking—serve as critical preconditions for COVID‐19 vaccination uptake in 2021. Using necessary condition analysis (NCA), we uncover nuanced and context‐specific impacts of distinct social capital on policy compliance. NCA also identifies threshold levels of various social capital required to achieve specific vaccination outcomes, yielding actionable diagnostics for policymakers and administrators. Strategies to raise compliance must align with local social capital configurations, prioritizing bridging in Republican‐leaning counties and relational support and careful use of bridging in Democratic‐leaning counties. The study advances civil society research by pinpointing the civic preconditions under which democratic institutions can function effectively in a polarized environment.
papers.abstract_zh: 政策遵循，即公民遵守政府政策的程度，仍是民主治理的核心考驗，尤其是在美國的COVID-19疫情期間。本研究探討不同形式的社會資本——關係型、結構型（連結型與橋接型）、認知型和垂直連結型——如何作為2021年COVID-19疫苗接種率的關鍵先決條件。運用必要條件分析（NCA），我們揭示了不同社會資本對政策遵循的細緻入微且具脈絡特異性的影響。NCA也識別出實現特定疫苗接種成果所需的各種社會資本閾值水平，為政策制定者和行政人員提供具體可行的診斷。提高遵循度的策略必須與當地社會資本配置相符，在共和黨傾向縣優先考慮橋接型社會資本，而在民主黨傾向縣則優先考慮關係型支持和謹慎使用橋接型社會資本。本研究藉由精確指出在兩極分化環境中民主制度能夠有效運作的公民先決條件，從而推進了公民社會研究。

papers.title: A Race to the Top: The Adoption of Net‐Zero City Pledges in Large US Cities
papers.abstract: Many cities have adopted net‐zero emission pledges, yet little is known about why these commitments emerge or how their determinants shift under changing policy environments. Using a panel of 148 large US cities from 2016 to 2022, this study applies the Political Market Framework and employs discrete‐time event‐history models to examine how policy demand, policy supply and institutional conditions shape adoption decisions. Results show that civic capacity, political ideology, and horizontal diffusion drive adoption in the full period, but their influence varies sharply across institutional contexts. During federal disengagement (2016–2018), cities with less population, strong vulnerability signals, supportive state policies, or fiscal cushioning through federal aid are more likely to adopt. When federal engagement returned (2019–2022), education, population size, and neighbor adoption emerged as significant correlates of net‐zero adoption. These findings extend the Political Market Framework by showing how federal contexts condition the adoption of ambitious climate commitments.
papers.abstract_zh: 許多城市已採納淨零排放承諾，然而對於這些承諾為何出現，以及其決定因素在不斷變化的政策環境下如何轉變，卻鮮為人知。本研究利用2016年至2022年間148個美國大型城市的追蹤資料，應用政治市場框架並採用離散時間事件史模型，探討政策需求、政策供給和制度條件如何影響採納決策。結果顯示，在整個研究期間，公民能力、政治意識形態和水平擴散是驅動採納的因素，但其影響在不同制度背景下存在顯著差異。在聯邦政府不介入時期（2016-2018年），人口較少、具有強烈脆弱性訊號、擁有支持性州政策或透過聯邦援助獲得財政緩衝的城市，更傾向於採納。當聯邦政府重新介入後（2019-2022年），教育程度、人口規模和鄰近城市採納成為淨零採納的顯著相關因素。這些研究結果透過揭示聯邦背景如何制約雄心勃勃的氣候承諾之採納，進而拓展了政治市場框架。

papers.title: Does Political Decoupling Through Fair Market Privatization Improve Managerial and Political Outcomes? Insights From Water Utility Sales
papers.abstract: Many U.S. municipalities face environmental service delivery challenges, including aging infrastructure and rising debt. In response, several states have adopted Fair Market Value (FMV) legislation, which aims to incentivize private firms to acquire and invest in municipal utilities—particularly in the water sector. However, the impacts of FMV privatization remain understudied. Guided by political decoupling theory, this study hypothesizes that FMV privatization improves drinking water utility management and local incumbent electoral outcomes. Using a difference‐in‐differences design, we analyze fifteen Illinois municipalities that sold their utilities after the state adopted FMV legislation relative to thirty‐four controls. Results suggest that FMV privatization improves personnel and technical management outcomes by reducing violations under the Safe Drinking Water Act but has no significant impact on incumbent vote share. These findings indicate that while FMV privatization may enhance utility management through political decoupling, its presumed political benefits warrant further investigation.
papers.abstract_zh: 許多美國地方政府面臨環境服務提供方面的挑戰，包括老舊基礎設施和不斷增加的債務。為此，數個州已採納公平市價 (FMV) 法規，旨在鼓勵私人企業收購並投資地方政府公用事業，特別是水務部門。然而，FMV 私有化的影響仍有待深入研究。本研究以政治脫鉤理論為指導，假設 FMV 私有化能改善飲用水公用事業管理和地方現任者的選舉結果。本研究採用雙重差分設計，分析了伊利諾州十五個在該州採納 FMV 法規後出售其公用事業的地方政府，並與三十四個對照組進行比較。結果顯示，FMV 私有化透過減少《安全飲用水法》下的違規行為，改善了人員和技術管理成效，但對現任者的得票率沒有顯著影響。這些發現表明，儘管 FMV 私有化可能透過政治脫鉤提升公用事業管理，但其預期的政治效益仍需進一步探討。

papers.title: Improving Cooperation in Government Purchasing Through Formal‐Relational Contracting
papers.abstract: A central challenge in government contracting is fostering cooperation between buyers and sellers where contract terms are incomplete. This article introduces a framework for formal‐relational contracting (FRC) in public sector contexts, where rigid regulations, competing values, and market imperfections make cooperation both difficult and valuable. FRC promotes cooperation through contract terms defining shared goals, guiding principles, and governance mechanisms. We present the theoretical foundations of FRC and examine its potential through 320 government contract management decision simulations where public contract managers acted as government buyers and business sellers facing sequential choices under both FRC contracts and the more conventional formal contracting approach. The results show that FRC increased managers' cooperative behavior by around 30 percentage points compared to formal contracting. Qualitative evidence further suggests that FRC shifted managers' mindsets from adversarial to cooperative. We discuss theoretical and practical implications for how FRC can enhance cooperation and mutual value in government contracting.
papers.abstract_zh: 在政府採購中，一個核心挑戰是如何在契約條款不完整的情況下，促進買方與賣方之間的合作。本文提出一個適用於公共部門情境的「正式關係契約」（Formal‐Relational Contracting, FRC）框架，在這些情境中，嚴格的法規、相互競爭的價值觀和市場不完全性，使得合作既困難又彌足珍貴。FRC透過定義共同目標、指導原則和治理機制的契約條款來促進合作。我們闡述了FRC的理論基礎，並透過320次政府契約管理決策模擬來檢視其潛力。在這些模擬中，公共契約經理人分別扮演政府買方和企業賣方，在FRC契約和更傳統的正式契約模式下，面臨依序選擇。結果顯示，相較於正式契約，FRC使經理人的合作行為增加了約30個百分點。質性證據進一步指出，FRC將經理人的心態從對立轉變為合作。我們討論了FRC如何在政府採購中增強合作和共同價值的理論與實務意涵。

papers.title: Institutional Amnesia and Public Administration: Does History Repeat?
papers.abstract: Existing research suggests that a lack of institutional memory causes history to repeat in problematic ways within public administration agencies. However, this claim has not been well supported by theory or data that illuminates the process and effects of history repeating. To remedy this, the nascent concept of institutional amnesia is presented here as a means of theorizing repetitions of public administrative history. A sequential explanatory mixed method research design uses quantitative survey data (n=1608) and qualitative interview data (n=75) generated in the public services of Australia, New Zealand and the United Kingdom to show how institutional amnesia can lead to the recycling of ideas and practices, the inefficient relearning of information seeking processes and the delivery of conducive decision-making environments that can help address historical problems. These findings draw attention to the fact that administrative history does indeed repeat in public agencies because of institutional amnesia, but that it does so in positive as well as negative ways.
papers.journal: Journal of Public Administration Research and Theory
papers.abstract_zh: 既有研究指出，機構記憶的缺乏導致歷史在公共行政機關中以問題化的方式重演。然而，此主張尚未獲得能夠闡明歷史重演過程與影響的理論或資料充分支持。為彌補此不足，本文提出新興的「機構失憶症」（institutional amnesia）概念，作為將公共行政歷史重演理論化的方法。本研究採用序列解釋性混合方法研究設計，運用來自澳洲、紐西蘭和英國公共服務部門的量化問卷資料（n=1608）和質化訪談資料（n=75），旨在揭示機構失憶症如何導致觀念與實踐的循環、資訊搜尋過程的低效再學習，以及提供有助於解決歷史問題的決策環境。這些研究結果指出，行政歷史確實會因為機構失憶症而在公共機關中重演，但其重演方式既有正面也有負面影響。

papers.title: Public Administration in the 21st Century: A Global South Perspective, 2nd ed. By RumkiBasu, London: Routledge, 2025. 182 pp.
Organizational Design for Public Managers By Mary E.Guy, Irvine, CA: Melvin & Leigh, Publishers, 2025. 208 pp. $44.95. ISBN : 979‐8‐99‐293050‐4
Public sector innovation management in the shadow: why the overlooked sibling still matters
papers.abstract: This paper examines innovation management as a deliberate organizational arrangement through which public organizations seek to remain relevant in contexts of uncertainty, technological and societal changes, and bureaucratic constraints. Drawing on a multiple-case study of five national police agencies, the study analyzes what works well and less well in systematic innovation management arrangements. While all agencies established innovation units with similar responsibilities, they differed in how innovation management systems were configured and sustained. Three configurations are identified – Strong Heavyweight, Light Heavyweight, and Lightweight – showing how enabling and constraining mechanisms help explain variation in innovation capacity across highly institutionalized public-sector contexts.
authors: Ana Paula Franco Paes Leme Barbosa
papers.abstract_zh: 本文旨在探討創新管理作為一種刻意的組織安排，公部門組織藉此在不確定性、科技與社會變遷以及官僚體制限制的脈絡中維持其重要性。本研究借鑒對五個國家警察機關的多案例研究，分析系統性創新管理安排中成效與不足之處。儘管各機關皆成立了職責相近的創新單位，但其創新管理系統的建構與維繫方式卻有所差異。本研究歸納出三種配置——強重量級、輕重量級和輕量級——揭示了促成與限制機制如何有助於解釋在高度制度化的公部門脈絡中創新能力的差異。

papers.title: Expansive Public Service Delivery: Advancing Public Value Governance
papers.abstract: Public administration has traditionally emphasized the normative ideal that public agencies have a responsibility to improve the lives of communities through public service delivery. We turn to public libraries to explore possibilities for what we call Expansive Public Service Delivery. Expansive Public Service Delivery is defined by a mission to serve all, professional and ethical responsibilities, and proactive responsiveness through outreach and (re)assessment. Public libraries have long aimed to improve communities and advance democracy by providing open, free information access to all. Today, they also proactively seek to expand their services to underserved groups ensuring their relevance and mission achievement. This research draws from 25 in‐depth qualitative interviews to explore librarian narratives to identify four core responsibilities that constitute Expansive Public Service Delivery. We conclude with a discussion of how service for all, professionalism, ethical responsibility, and reflexive decision‐making around community needs can result in more vibrant, sustainable public organizations.
papers.abstract_zh: 公共行政傳統上強調一種規範性理想，即公共機關負有透過公共服務提供來改善社區生活之責。本研究轉向公共圖書館，以探討我們稱之為「擴展性公共服務提供」的可能性。「擴展性公共服務提供」之定義為：以服務全民為使命，並透過外展服務與（重新）評估，展現專業與倫理責任及主動回應。公共圖書館長期以來致力於透過向全民提供開放且免費的資訊近用，以改善社區並促進民主。現今，他們也主動尋求將服務擴展至服務不足的族群，以確保其相關性與使命達成。本研究取材自 25 份深度質性訪談，探討圖書館員的敘事，以識別出構成擴展性公共服務提供的四項核心責任。本文最後將討論服務全民、專業精神、倫理責任以及圍繞社區需求的反思性決策，如何能促成更具活力且永續的公共組織。

papers.title: Face‐to‐Face With Administrative Burdens: Design Simplification, Emotional Costs, and Procedural Outcomes in Digital Welfare Applications
papers.abstract: Recent scholarship on administrative burden has increasingly focused on psychological costs, design interventions, and digital burdens. This study combines these interests and examines the psychological costs of negative emotions during administrative encounters at varying levels of digital maturity. Building on affective events theory and employing facial coding in a controlled experiment, the study demonstrates that negative emotions rise during bureaucratic encounters, with frustration resulting in more errors made by applicants. Simplifying the procedure through pre‐filled forms does not reduce negative emotional arousal; however, it enhances satisfaction with the procedure. Vulnerable citizens, as indicated by low education and foreign citizenship, benefit more from this informational integration than other groups, suggesting that procedural redesign can enhance the inclusiveness of public service delivery. Overall, the research advances both scholarly and practical understanding of the emotional dimension of administrative burdens from a process‐oriented perspective, highlighting the persistent challenge of reducing emotional costs to enhance citizen experiences.
papers.abstract_zh: 近期關於行政負擔的學術研究越來越關注心理成本、設計介入和數位負擔。本研究結合這些關注點，探討在不同數位成熟度下，行政互動中負面情緒所產生的心理成本。本研究立基於情感事件理論，並在一項控制實驗中採用臉部編碼，結果顯示在官僚互動中負面情緒會升高，且挫折感會導致申請人犯下更多錯誤。透過預填表格簡化程序並未減少負面情緒的激發；然而，它卻能提升對程序的滿意度。弱勢公民，表現為低教育程度和外國公民身份者，從這種資訊整合中獲益比其他群體更多，這表明程序再設計能提升公共服務提供的包容性。總體而言，本研究從過程導向的角度，增進了學術和實務兩方面對行政負擔情感層面的理解，突顯了減少情感成本以提升公民體驗的持續挑戰。

papers.title: Contingent capacity: navigating organizational dependency in Dutch municipal energy transitions
papers.abstract: Municipalities implementing energy transition mandates rely on contingent workers to fill capacity and expertise gaps, raising concerns about dependency and knowledge loss. Drawing on Resource Dependence Theory and client–consultant literature, this study develops a framework capturing the feedback loop between external reliance and internal capacity development. Fifteen interviews across six Dutch municipalities show that labour shortages and temporary subsidies drive contingent hiring, while short contracts and limited knowledge transfer heighten dependency. Municipalities facing similar constraints diverge through knowledge integration, governance arrangements, and relational dynamics. It advances public administration scholarship by conceptualising dependency as a process rather than structural outcome.
papers.abstract_zh: 執行能源轉型任務的地方政府仰賴契約人員來彌補能力與專業知識的缺口，這引發了對依賴性與知識流失的擔憂。本研究借鑒資源依賴理論以及客戶-顧問關係文獻，發展出一個框架，以呈現外部依賴與內部能力發展之間的循環回饋。對六個荷蘭地方政府進行的十五次訪談顯示，人力短缺與臨時性補助驅動了契約人員的聘用，而短期契約與有限的知識移轉則加劇了依賴性。面臨相似限制的地方政府，透過知識整合、治理機制與關係動態而呈現分歧。本研究藉由將依賴性概念化為一個過程而非結構性結果，推進了公共行政學術。

Unleashing the potential of participative budgeting practices in Public Healthcare Organizations: The drivers of psychology-based budgeting research
papers.abstract: Since doctors heading operational units have become budget holders, the hybrid nature of doctor-managers exposes them to risks of role ambiguity. Drawing on psychology-based budgeting research, this study explores how participative budgeting (PB) can enhance managerial responses to budgetary responsibilities. Using data from 131 doctor-managers in Italian public healthcare organizations, we found that providing satisfactory budgetary information influences doctor-managers’ perceptions of organizational support (POS). The ‘reciprocating’ response driven by POS strengthens doctor-managers’ motivation to achieve budgetary goals and involvement in PB, acting as an enabling condition for role hybridization. This results in improvements in psychological well-being and organizational identification.
papers.abstract_zh: 由於擔任營運單位主管的醫師已身兼預算負責人，醫師經理人身分的雙重性使其面臨角色模糊的風險。本研究借鑒心理學取向的預算編制研究，探討參與式預算 (PB) 如何增強管理者對預算責任的回應。本研究利用來自義大利公共醫療機構中 131 位醫師經理人的數據，發現提供令人滿意的預算資訊會影響醫師經理人的組織支持知覺 (POS)。由組織支持知覺 (POS) 所驅動的「互惠」回應，強化了醫師經理人達成預算目標的動機以及對參與式預算的投入，並作為角色混合的促成條件。這進而提升了心理福祉和組織認同。

papers.title: Issue Information
Co-creation in commissioning complex public services: towards an adaptive system for continuous improvement
papers.abstract: This article explores co-creation to address complex societal problems in the interconnected domains of health, welfare, and security. An instrumental case study examines the innovative outcome-based commissioning of public services for people engaging in problematic drug use in a Finnish city. We apply abductive content analysis to interviews with public and private stakeholders, documents, and statistics gathered from 2015 to 2021. The findings suggest that co-creation, co-production, and co-destruction combine to form an adaptive system that can foster continuous improvement in the provision of public value.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文探討協同創造如何解決健康、福利與安全等相互關聯領域中的複雜社會問題。一項工具性個案研究，檢視了芬蘭某城市針對藥物濫用者所提供的公共服務中，創新的成果導向委託模式。我們運用溯因內容分析法，分析2015年至2021年間收集的公共與私人利害關係人訪談、文件及統計數據。研究結果顯示，協同創造、協同生產與協同破壞結合形成一個適應性系統，有助於促進公共價值提供上的持續改善。

papers.title: Anchoring during a storm: unveiling the role of Anchor institutions in place-based public service ecosystems during disruption
papers.abstract: This article investigates the role of an Anchor Institution (Anchor) within a place-based public service ecosystem (PSE) during disruption. Specifically, it examines how Anchors shape the conditions under which actors can participate in value creation. Drawing on a qualitative single-case study of the University of Siena, an Anchor embedded in a city-campus where students, services, and territorial actors are closely intertwined, we show how disruption activates the Anchor’s multi-level role unevenly. While some actors are enabled to participate and mobilize resources for value creation, others are constrained from doing so. Crucially, we also theorize a new relational mechanism, which we term ‘reverse anchoring’. This mechanism captures how other PSE actors mobilize resources (e.g. venues) to support the restoration of the Anchor’s multi-level role. In doing so, the article offers a novel account of PSE robustness, showing that it also arises from the involvement of peripheral PSE actors.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文探討在擾動期間，錨定機構（Anchor）在地公共服務生態系統（PSE）中所扮演的角色。具體而言，本研究檢視錨定機構如何形塑行動者得以參與價值創造的條件。本文借鑒一項以錫耶納大學為例的質性單一案例研究，該大學是一個根植於城鎮校園的錨定機構，學生、服務與在地行動者在此緊密交織。研究結果顯示，擾動如何不均勻地啟動錨定機構的多層次角色。儘管有些行動者得以參與並動員資源進行價值創造，其他行動者卻受限而無法做到。關鍵的是，本研究也提出一種新的關係機制，我們稱之為「反向錨定」（reverse anchoring）。此機制闡明了其他PSE行動者如何動員資源（例如：場地）以支持錨定機構多層次角色的恢復。藉此，本文對PSE韌性提供了一個新穎的解釋，顯示其也源於周邊PSE行動者的參與。

papers.title: The Disconnection of Advocacy and Analysis in Public Administration: A Critique of Robust Governance
papers.abstract: A strength of public administration as a discipline is that it is concerned with both the analysis and advocacy. It explores the working of public institutions and wider systems of governance but also proposes reform mechanisms to improve their functioning. But these combined tasks are often conducted as if they were in separate worlds, to the detriment of the advocacy role. This failing, in turn, leads the advocacy arm of public administration regularly down a path of misunderstanding the nature of reform, over‐estimating the prospects for institutional change and not grasping the role of politics in any change. We use the case of the recent promotion of “robust governance” to illustrate our argument.
papers.abstract_zh: 公共行政學作為一門學科，其優勢在於兼顧分析與倡議。它探討公共機構與更廣泛治理體系的運作，同時也提出改革機制以改善其運作。然而，這些綜合任務卻常被視為互不相干，損害了倡議角色的發揮。這種缺失進而導致公共行政的倡議面向，經常誤解改革的本質、過度高估制度變革的前景，且未能掌握政治在任何變革中的作用。我們以近期推動的「穩健治理」為例，闡明我們的論點。
