papers.title: Understanding co-production with vulnerable populations: challenges, enablers and outcomes
papers.abstract: Co-production emerged to engage users in public services as an intrinsic source of value and a democratic right, generating empowerment and social capital. This normative promise is undermined by an equity problem: vulnerable populations face barriers to full participation and are systematically excluded from co-productive processes despite having the greatest need for public services. Although attention to this issue has grown, the literature lacks a comprehensive cross-sector, cross-population analysis. A systematic literature review combining bibliometric mapping with qualitative narrative synthesis is conducted, placing vulnerability and its consequences for the co-production process at the centre of inquiry. This article contributes to co-production theory by highlighting the limits of standard assumptions for vulnerable populations, and offers practical implications for designing inclusive co-production processes.
papers.abstract_zh: 協同生產的出現旨在讓使用者參與公共服務，視其為內在價值來源與民主權利，並產生賦權與社會資本。然而，這項規範性承諾卻因公平性問題而受損：弱勢族群面臨充分參與的障礙，儘管他們對公共服務的需求最大，卻系統性地被排除在協同生產過程之外。儘管對此議題的關注日益增加，文獻卻缺乏全面的跨部門、跨族群分析。本文進行了一項系統性文獻回顧，結合文獻計量繪圖與質性敘事綜合分析，將脆弱性及其對協同生產過程的影響置於探究的核心。本文透過突顯標準假設對弱勢族群的局限性，對協同生產理論有所貢獻，並為設計具包容性的協同生產過程提供實務意涵。

papers.title: When you make and buy: understanding service delivery portfolios in concurrent sourcing
papers.abstract: Concurrent sourcing, the simultaneous use of in-house provision and contracting out, remains underexplored. This study examines how the allocation between in-house and contracted modes in service delivery portfolios affects service performance. Using panel data on children’s social care services provided by English local authorities from 2014 to 2023, we find that concentrated portfolios, in which one delivery mode dominates and the other plays a supporting role, are associated with better performance. By contrast, dominant mode itself and the mix of contractor types within outsourced provision show limited influence. The findings highlight portfolio design as central to concurrent sourcing.
papers.abstract_zh: 並行採購，即同時採用內部供應與委外服務，仍未獲得充分探討。本研究探討服務提供組合中，內部與委外模式之間的配置如何影響服務績效。本研究利用2014年至2023年間英國地方政府提供的兒童社會福利服務面板資料，發現集中式組合（即其中一種交付模式佔主導地位，另一種則扮演輔助角色）與較佳績效相關。相較之下，主導模式本身以及委外服務中承攬商類型的組合則影響有限。本研究結果突顯組合設計對於並行採購至關重要。

papers.title: Beyond co-creation: how non-profit organizations create public value in complex social challenges
papers.abstract: This article explores how public value is created in the complex and contested field of refugee integration, identifing three key arenas – service delivery, social and community activities, and advocacy – whereby NPOs create value in the multiple domains of refugee integration. We develop a conceptual model illustrating mechanisms of public value creation from the perspective of NPOs (full co-creation, societal creation of value between volunteers and service users only, and contestation), highlighting the roles of local and refugee volunteers. We contribute to public management scholarship by advancing theoretical understanding of how value is created in politicized policy fields and by whom.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文旨在探討公共價值如何在複雜且充滿爭議的難民融合領域中產生，並指出非營利組織（NPOs）透過服務提供、社會與社區活動以及倡議這三個關鍵場域，在難民融合的多元面向中創造價值。本研究建立了一個概念模型，從非營利組織的角度闡釋公共價值創造的機制（包括完全共創、僅限志工與服務使用者之間的社會價值創造，以及爭議），並強調在地志工與難民志工的角色。本文透過推進關於價值如何在政治化的政策領域中產生以及由誰產生的理論理解，對公共管理學術領域有所貢獻。

papers.title: Building collaborative governance from scratch: the significance of recalibration and reaffirmation in boundary work
papers.abstract: This paper examines the dynamics of actors’ boundary work in collaborative governance. While widely studied, how actors navigate collaborative governance from its inception has been underexplored. Drawing on a longitudinal ethnographic study tracing actors’ struggles over boundaries in response to a collaboration mandate, this paper demonstrates (1) how the design (configurational boundary work) of collaborative governance inadvertently and sometimes adversely affects the collaboration; (2) how collaborative governance remains ‘under construction’ as actors switch between competitive and collaborative boundary work; and (3) how actors continually engage in ‘recalibration’ and ‘reaffirmation’ of boundary work in response to changing circumstances, tasks, and actors.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文探討行動者在協作治理中進行邊界工作的動態。儘管協作治理已被廣泛研究，但行動者如何從其建立之初駕馭協作治理，卻未被充分探討。本文基於一項縱貫民族誌研究，該研究追溯行動者為回應一項協作要求而在邊界上進行的掙扎，並闡明：(1) 協作治理的設計（配置性邊界工作）如何無意中，有時甚至不利地影響協作；(2) 隨著行動者在競爭性與協作性邊界工作之間切換，協作治理如何持續處於「建構中」的狀態；以及 (3) 行動者如何為應對不斷變化的情境、任務和行動者，持續地參與邊界工作的「重新校準」與「再確認」。

papers.title: Forged through forces: configurations to digital policy attention in local governments
papers.abstract: Although governments’ digital policy attention is pivotal for effective digital governance, the mechanisms shaping attention remain insufficiently understood. Drawing on an integrated view of institutional environment, task environment, and resource endowment, we analyse 272 Chinese prefecture-level cities using a hybrid fsQCA – regression method to examine how multiple conditions jointly shape attention to digital transformation. We find that normative pressure, fiscal capacity, economic conditions, and digital infrastructure provide the foundation for high policy attention. Beyond this base, we identify three configurations across these dimensions: capability alignment, where leaders with technocratic backgrounds and digital culture jointly foster endogenous commitment; pressure compliance, where coercive, mimetic, and normative pressures jointly drive policy attention; and peer learning adaptation, where governments enhance attention through horizontal emulation when top-down mandates are weak. Regression analyses show that pressure compliance exerts the strongest influence on digital policy attention. These findings reveal configurational dynamics underlying digital governance.
papers.abstract_zh: 儘管政府對數位政策的關注對於有效的數位治理至關重要，但影響關注度的機制仍未被充分理解。本研究借鑒制度環境、任務環境和資源稟賦的整合觀點，分析了中國272個地級市，採用混合式模糊集質性比較分析 (fsQCA) 與迴歸分析方法，以檢視多重條件如何共同形塑對數位轉型的關注。我們發現，規範壓力、財政能力、經濟條件和數位基礎設施為高政策關注度奠定了基礎。在此基礎之上，我們識別出跨越這些維度的三種配置：「能力校準」（其中具有技術官僚背景和數位文化的領導者共同促進內生承諾）、「壓力遵循」（其中強制性、模仿性和規範性壓力共同驅動政策關注）以及「同儕學習調適」（其中當自上而下的指令較弱時，政府透過橫向模仿來提升關注度）。迴歸分析顯示，「壓力遵循」對數位政策關注度產生最強烈的影響。這些發現揭示了數位治理背後的配置動態。

papers.title: Empowering Employability for a Sustainable Future: How HR Practices Support Workers with Disabilities in the Public Sector in the Netherlands
papers.abstract: The Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) emphasize inclusive economic growth (SDG 8) and reduced inequalities (SDG 10), including equal employment opportunities for workers with disabilities (WWDs). Despite international and national efforts, WWDs still face barriers to labor market participation. Public sector organizations are expected to lead in inclusive HRM but often lag behind in employing WWDs, raising concerns about their ability to contribute to the SDGs. Using Social Exchange Theory and Self Determination Theory, we examine how three HR practices of training and development, workplace accommodations, and establishing clear expectations affect the employability of 313 WWDs in a Dutch public sector organization. Survey data were analyzed using confirmatory factor analysis and regression-based mediation analysis. Findings show that HR practices primarily impact employability mediated through basic psychological needs satisfaction, with limited direct effects. This study offers empirical insights on how inclusive HRM in the public sector can advance the SDGs.
papers.abstract_zh: 永續發展目標 (SDGs) 強調具包容性的經濟成長 (SDG 8) 和減少不平等 (SDG 10)，其中包括為身心障礙者 (WWDs) 提供平等就業機會。儘管國際和國內持續努力，身心障礙者在勞動市場參與方面仍面臨障礙。公部門組織被期望能引領具包容性的人力資源管理，但在僱用身心障礙者方面卻常落後，這引發了對其能否有效貢獻永續發展目標的擔憂。本研究運用社會交換理論和自我決定理論，探討訓練與發展、工作場所調整以及建立明確期望這三種人力資源實務，如何影響一家荷蘭公部門組織中313位身心障礙者的就業能力。問卷資料採用驗證性因素分析和迴歸基礎的中介分析進行處理。研究結果顯示，人力資源實務主要透過基本心理需求滿足來中介影響就業能力，而直接效果則有限。本研究為公部門中具包容性的人力資源管理如何推進永續發展目標，提供了實證見解。

papers.title: The promise and performance of social impact bonds
papers.abstract: This article examines social impact bonds (SIBs), first scrutinizing early discourse on their promises—increased accountability through competitive public-private partnerships, outcomes measurement, and a learning approach to performance management—drawing on theories of New Public Management and New Public Governance. Then, a structured review of empirical research is used to evaluate SIB performance against their public management reform promises. Findings show that while SIBs sometimes foster intersectoral collaboration, they can also surface power imbalances, institutionalize gaming, and inadvertently reduce public accountability. A faltering commitment to robust outcomes measurement is also demonstrated, with negative implications for effective governance and public value.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文檢視社會影響債券 (SIBs)，首先審視其早期論述所提出的承諾——透過競爭性公私協力夥伴關係、成效衡量以及績效管理的學習取向來強化課責性——並援引新公共管理與新公共治理理論。接著，本文採用結構化的實證研究回顧，旨在評估SIBs的績效是否符合其公共管理改革的承諾。研究發現，SIBs雖然有時能促進跨部門協作，卻也可能揭示權力失衡、制度化鑽營行為，並可能無意間削弱公共課責性。此外，對嚴謹的成效衡量承諾亦顯動搖，對於有效治理與公共價值造成負面影響。

papers.title: The Hidden Costs of Red Tape: Exploring the Physical Toll of Red Tape on Teachers
papers.abstract: When rules impose compliance burdens that outweigh their contribution to teachers’ objectives or values, they are experienced as red tape . Given red tape’s negative consequences, it is concerning that teachers worldwide report being confronted with high levels of red tape in their jobs. Drawing on Job Demands-Resources theory and Affective Events Theory, this study investigates the relationship between teachers’ red tape perceptions and physical complaints (e.g., neck pain and headaches). Specifically, we explore the mediating role of work-related anger in this relationship and investigate whether servant leadership moderates the negative effects of red tape. We collected time-lagged data from 717 teachers in Flemish schools. Structural Equation Modeling revealed a positive relationship between red tape and physical complaints, mediated by work-related anger. Furthermore, the results indicate that when teachers perceive their school leader as a servant leader, work-related anger is less affected by red tape, which indirectly reduces their physical complaints.
papers.abstract_zh: 當規章制度所造成的遵循負擔，超過其對教師目標或價值的貢獻時，這些規章制度便被視為繁文縟節。鑑於繁文縟節的負面影響，全球教師普遍反映在工作中面臨高度的繁文縟節，此現象令人擔憂。本研究借鑒工作要求-資源理論（Job Demands-Resources theory）和情感事件理論（Affective Events Theory），探討教師對繁文縟節的感知與身體不適（例如：頸部疼痛和頭痛）之間的關係。具體而言，我們探討工作相關憤怒在此關係中的中介作用，並研究僕人式領導（servant leadership）是否能調節繁文縟節的負面影響。我們收集了來自法蘭德斯地區學校717位教師的跨時間點資料。結構方程模型（Structural Equation Modeling, SEM）分析結果顯示，繁文縟節與身體不適之間存在正向關係，且此關係由工作相關憤怒所中介。此外，結果指出，當教師將其學校領導者視為僕人式領導者時，工作相關憤怒較不受繁文縟節的影響，進而間接減少其身體不適。

papers.title: “You Keep Using That Word. I do not Think it Means What you Think it Means”: Interjurisdictional Equity in Local Option Tax Policy
papers.abstract: Fairness in tax policy is a widely shared goal among scholars, policymakers, and the public, yet equity remains a contested concept. This study examines interjurisdictional equity in the context of local option taxes (LOTs), which have become an increasingly significant revenue source for local governments. While much of the existing research on LOTs focuses on competition, rate setting, and adoption, this paper considers how different dimensions of equity intersect in shaping their implementation and effects and presents an analytical framework that can be applied to understanding interjurisdictional equity more holistically. Using a North Carolina local sales tax revenue policy designed to distribute revenues more equitably, this study analyzes county-level data from 2013 to 2019 to assess the policy's impact across multiple equity measures. The findings highlight complementary and conflicting equity considerations, underscoring the need for policymakers to clearly define their equity objectives to achieve desired policy outcomes. This research contributes to a more nuanced understanding of fairness in local public finance.
papers.journal: The American Review of Public Administration
papers.abstract_zh: 租稅政策的公平性是學者、政策制定者和公眾之間普遍認同的目標，然而，衡平性仍是一個備受爭議的概念。本研究探討在地方選擇性稅收（LOTs）的背景下的跨轄區衡平性，此類稅收已成為地方政府日益重要的財政收入來源。儘管現有關於地方選擇性稅收的研究多著重於競爭、稅率設定和採行，本文則探討衡平性的不同面向如何交織影響其執行與成效，並提出一個分析框架，可用於更全面地理解跨轄區衡平性。本研究以北卡羅來納州一項旨在更公平分配稅收的地方銷售稅政策為例，分析2013年至2019年的縣級數據，以評估該政策在多個衡平性指標上的影響。研究結果突顯了互補與衝突的衡平性考量，強調政策制定者需明確界定其衡平性目標，以實現預期的政策成效。本研究有助於在地方公共財政領域中，更細緻地理解公平性。

papers.title: Public value as care within and for practices
papers.abstract: This article draws on practice theory and care theory to conceptualize public value as care within and for the practices to which citizens are entitled. In doing so, it contributes by theoretically integrating major strands of public value research. More specifically, it shows that strategic management of public value depends on the sustained care for practices; that contestation over public value centres on struggles over what should be cared for; that the cocreation and codestruction of public value depend on the extent to which practices are carefully sustained; and that public values are normatively grounded in care and become visible through enacted practices. The article also outlines practical implications for addressing pressing collective challenges through policy design and demonstrates how legitimacy, management, and accountability are reconfigured when public value is understood as care within and for the practices to which citizens are entitled.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文立基於實踐理論與關懷理論，將公共價值概念化為在公民應享有的實踐中，並為其所做的關懷。藉此，本文的貢獻在於從理論上整合了公共價值研究的各個主要流派。更具體地說，本文指出：公共價值的策略性管理取決於對實踐的持續關懷；對公共價值的爭議核心在於對「應關懷什麼」的爭奪；公共價值的共創與共毀仰賴於實踐被審慎維護的程度；以及公共價值在規範上根植於關懷，並透過實踐行動而顯現。本文也概述了透過政策設計來應對緊迫集體挑戰的實務意涵，並闡明了當公共價值被理解為在公民應享有的實踐中，並為其所做的關懷時，正當性、管理與問責將如何被重新配置。

papers.title: Conceptualizing and Measuring the Rule of Law in Public Administration—Regulations, Organization, and Decision-Making
papers.abstract: The rule of law is foundational to Public Administration (PA), yet the field has long lacked a clear conceptualization of what the rule of law entails and, furthermore, an objective measurement system. Grounded in the “thin” conception of the rule of law and integrated within the public administration context, we propose a three-dimensional framework: Regulations, Organization, and Decision-making. We operationalize this framework as the Public Administration Rule of Law Index (PARLI), a composite measure built from three level-1 and seven level-2 indicators, using objective data to ensure replicability. We apply this index to measure the rule of law in China's 31 provinces (2020–2024) and validate it by examining its relationship with key socioeconomic outcomes. The results align with theoretical expectations: PARLI scores are positively correlated with entrepreneurship and innovation but negatively correlated with government responsiveness. These findings simultaneously confirm the measure's validity and reveal the inherent tensions in applying the rule of law within the public administration. This study makes two primary contributions. First, it provides scholars with a coherent framework to overcome knowledge fragmentation and cumulate scientific inquiry. Second, it offers a replicable and objective measurement toolkit for policy analysis.
papers.journal: The American Review of Public Administration
papers.abstract_zh: 法治是公共行政 (PA) 的基礎，然而，該領域長期以來缺乏對法治意涵的清晰概念化，此外，也缺乏客觀的衡量系統。本研究立基於「薄」法治概念，並整合於公共行政脈絡中，提出一個三維框架：規章、組織與決策。我們將此框架操作化為公共行政法治指數 (PARLI)，這是一個由三個第一層級與七個第二層級指標建構而成的綜合性衡量指標，並採用客觀數據以確保其可複製性。我們將此指數應用於衡量中國 31 個省份的法治狀況 (2020-2024年)，並透過檢視其與關鍵社會經濟成果的關係來驗證其有效性。研究結果符合理論預期：PARLI 分數與創業和創新呈正相關，但與政府回應性呈負相關。這些發現同時證實了該衡量指標的有效性，並揭示了在公共行政中應用法治時所固有的張力。本研究有兩項主要貢獻。首先，它為學者提供一個連貫的框架，以克服知識碎片化並累積科學探究。其次，它提供一個可複製且客觀的衡量工具包，供政策分析使用。

papers.title: Navigating challenges at the frontline: evidence from Youth Outreach Unit (YOU) in marginalized communities
papers.abstract: Police-led youth programs provide mentorship and support for youth in marginalized communities, yet limited research examines their implementation challenges and adaptive strategies. This qualitative study investigates the Youth Outreach Unit (YOU) in Miami-Dade County, Florida, using virtual semi-structured interviews with program leaders and officers. Findings identify three key implementation challenges: resource constraints, understaffing and limited expertise, and unclear goals and performance metrics. We further identify three pathways for improvement: formal partnerships and community collaboration, strategic use of goal ambiguity, and clearer metrics, protocols, and accountability mechanisms. The study offers policy implications for designing and supporting community-based youth programs.
papers.abstract_zh: 警方主導的青少年計畫為邊緣化社區的青少年提供指導與支持，然而，鮮少有研究探討其實施挑戰與調適策略。本質性研究旨在調查佛羅里達州邁阿密-戴德縣的青少年外展單位 (YOU)，透過與計畫領導者和警員進行虛擬半結構式訪談。研究結果指出三項主要的實施挑戰：資源限制、人力不足與專業知識有限，以及目標不明確與績效指標不清。我們進一步提出三項改進途徑：正式夥伴關係與社區合作、策略性地運用目標模糊性，以及更明確的指標、規範與課責機制。本研究為設計與支持以社區為基礎的青少年計畫提供政策意涵。

papers.title: Strategic narratives and the processes of goal achievement in municipal strategic planning
papers.abstract: This study examines how strategic narratives shape strategic planning processes in ways that support the pursuit of municipal goals. Drawing on a longitudinal case study of a French municipality and combining analysis of council deliberations, documentary materials, and interviews, it shows that strategic narratives link planning to implementation. The findings reveal how temporality, positioning, and performative intent interact to generate municipal strategic capacity by sustaining coherence, structuring multi-actor alignment, and mobilizing engagement over time. The study contributes to public management research by integrating a narrative perspective with strategic planning scholarship and showing how strategic narratives become embedded in municipal practices.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究探討策略敘事如何塑造策略規劃過程，以支持市政目標的實現。本研究以一項針對法國市鎮的縱貫性個案研究為基礎，並結合市議會審議、文件資料及訪談的分析，結果顯示策略敘事將規劃與執行連結起來。研究結果揭示了時間性、定位與展演意圖如何互動，透過維持一致性、建構多方行動者的協調一致，並隨著時間推移動員參與，進而產生市政策略能力。本研究透過整合敘事觀點與策略規劃學術研究，並揭示策略敘事如何嵌入市政實踐之中，從而對公共管理研究有所貢獻。

papers.title: A social enterprise management framework for creating hybrid value within public service ecosystems
papers.abstract: Social enterprises (SEs) increasingly deliver public services while generating multiple forms of value. This study of 10 SEs uses 40 interviews from three different public service areas to reveal how hybrid value is created across different ecosystem levels. Hybrid value is shown to emerge through a range of interventions and enabling dimensions that generate individual, social, and public value. However, value creation is not always guaranteed, as tensions across ecosystem levels increase the risk of value co-destruction. Our primary contribution is a framework for hybrid value creation in public service ecosystems, advancing understanding of how value is created and sustained.
papers.abstract_zh: 社會企業（SEs）日益提供公共服務，同時創造多元形式的價值。本研究針對10家社會企業，透過來自三個不同公共服務領域的40次訪談，揭示了混合價值如何在不同生態系統層次中被創造。研究顯示，混合價值是透過一系列的干預措施和促成面向而產生，這些措施和面向創造了個人、社會和公共價值。然而，價值創造並非總能被保證，因為跨生態系統層次的張力增加了價值共毀的風險。本研究的主要貢獻是提出一個公共服務生態系統中混合價值創造的框架，增進了對價值如何被創造和維持的理解。

papers.title: Whose responsibility is it anyway? Unpacking prevention during service delivery to support value co-creation
papers.abstract: Preventive reforms typically emphasize individual responsibility or the mobilization of community assets, but an enduring implementation gap exists. The ongoing stalemate calls for a fundamental shift in the way public services are understood and delivered. Central to this shift is understanding the complex interplay between roles, responsbility and multi-layered contexts shaping service delivery and outcomes. Drawing on qualitative research on health and social care, we explore how roles, responsibilities and service delivery approaches are framed. Through our analysis, we propose three broad approaches to service delivery, contributing to the nascent literature on value co-creation in complex public service settings.
papers.abstract_zh: 預防性改革通常側重於個人責任或社區資產的動員，但卻存在著持久的執行落差。持續的僵局亟需在公共服務的理解與提供方式上進行根本性的轉變。這項轉變的核心在於理解角色、責任以及塑造服務提供與成果的多重脈絡之間複雜的交互作用。本文借鑒健康與社會照護領域的質性研究，探討角色、責任與服務提供取徑是如何被建構的。藉由本文分析，我們提出三種廣泛的服務提供取徑，旨在貢獻於複雜公共服務場域中價值共創的新興文獻。

papers.title: Transnational Nonprofit Action: Diaspora Giving, Collective and Social Remittances, and the Provision of Public Goods and Services
papers.abstract: This article explores transnational nonprofit action through diaspora-led nonprofit organizations in the United States (U.S.) and their funding and support of public goods and services in the home country. Diaspora communities around the world make contributions to their homelands in various ways that have impact on public governance. Specifically, diaspora members engage in philanthropic giving behaviors towards their countries of origin, including via collective and social remittances. How does this diaspora giving contribute to the provision of public goods and services in the country of origin? This research uses a multi-sited, comparative case study design that included extensive fieldwork in the U.S. and Colombia, and the transnational space between these settings. Building on theory about public governance and nonprofit organizations, the research generates and further explores empirically a framework of three sets of resources that condition transnational nonprofit action—material, relational, and institutional. Material resources illuminate how diaspora-funded projects directly support public service delivery. Relational resources capture how trust, credibility, and embedded community ties via diaspora-led organizations provide access to both networks and funding sources. Institutional resources, namely norm-setting, explain how collective and social remittances have the potential to shape expectations, standards, and practices about the nonprofit sector, philanthropic giving, and public governance more broadly.
papers.journal: The American Review of Public Administration
papers.abstract_zh: 本文探討美國僑民主導的非營利組織所進行的跨國非營利行動，及其對母國公共財與服務的資助與支持。全球各地的僑民社群以多種方式對其母國做出貢獻，並對公共治理產生影響。具體而言，僑民成員對其原籍國從事慈善捐贈行為，包括透過集體與社會匯款。這種僑民捐贈如何有助於原籍國公共財與服務的提供？本研究採用多地點、比較個案研究設計，其中包含在美國、哥倫比亞以及這些場域之間的跨國空間進行的廣泛田野調查。本研究立基於公共治理與非營利組織的理論，實證地建構並進一步探討一個由三類資源組成的架構，這些資源制約著跨國非營利行動—物質、關係與制度資源。物質資源闡明了僑民資助的計畫如何直接支持公共服務的提供。關係資源說明了信任、信譽和透過僑民主導組織建立的深厚社群連結，如何提供接觸網絡和資金來源的機會。制度資源，亦即規範設定，解釋了集體與社會匯款如何有潛力塑造關於非營利部門、慈善捐贈以及更廣泛的公共治理的期望、標準和實踐。

papers.title: Exploring How Demand and Supply Knowledge Can Improve Centralized Public Health Procurement
papers.abstract: Despite the growing shift towards procurement centralization among governments around the world, questions remain as to how to increase purchasing within centralized frameworks. While centralized purchasing offers many benefits related to efficiency and quality control, users often prefer more flexible options for purchasing. An unanswered question is how knowledge of user requirements and market trends leads to framework agreements that reduce the inclination for users to purchase goods and services on their own. This study employs healthcare purchasing data from 21 regions in Italy from 2013–2023 to explore how different sources of knowledge about demand and supply affect centralization rates—both in respect to asset-specific and non-asset-specific products. Fixed effects regression results indicate that knowledge of supply gleaned from integrating technical experts into procurement teams enhances centralization for a range of offerings. The influence of demand-related knowledge on centralized purchasing varies by product type, however, with interpersonal exchanges proving more effective for non-asset-specific categories and logistical support mechanisms proving more critical for asset-specific product categories. The results provide longitudinal insights into conditions that are typically studied through cross-sectional data. They also offer important implications for the many countries operating publicly provided health programs, as well as those pursuing broader reforms tied to procurement centralization.
papers.journal: The American Review of Public Administration
papers.abstract_zh: 儘管全球各國政府日益轉向採購集中化，但在集中化框架內如何提高採購量仍是個懸而未決的問題。雖然集中化採購在效率和品質控制方面帶來諸多好處，但使用者通常偏好更具彈性的採購選項。一個未解的問題是，對使用者需求和市場趨勢的了解，如何促成框架協議，進而降低使用者自行採購商品與服務的傾向。本研究利用2013年至2023年間義大利21個地區的醫療採購資料，探討不同來源的需求與供給知識如何影響集中化程度——包括資產專屬產品和非資產專屬產品。固定效果迴歸分析結果顯示，將技術專家納入採購團隊所獲得的供給知識，能提升多種產品的集中化程度。然而，需求相關知識對集中化採購的影響因產品類型而異：人際交流對於非資產專屬類別更為有效，而後勤支援機制對於資產專屬產品類別則更為關鍵。本研究結果提供了對通常透過橫斷面資料研究的條件的縱向見解。這些結果也對許多實施公共醫療計畫的國家，以及那些推動與採購集中化相關的更廣泛改革的國家，提供了重要的啟示。

papers.title: Correction
papers.abstract: Article title: Expanding Kelman’s vision for digital transformation in public procurementAuthors: Winiarska, M. and Kizielewicz, J.Journal: International Public Management Journal procurementDOI:ht...
papers.abstract_zh: 本文透過提出一個整合技術、組織和制度因素的全面性框架，擴展了 Kelman 在公共採購數位轉型方面的願景。基於系統性文獻回顧和個案研究的實證見解，我們識別出成功數位轉型的關鍵驅動因素和障礙，並強調了領導力、利害關係人參與和法規調適的關鍵作用。所提出的框架為旨在利用數位科技以提升公共採購效率、透明度和問責性的政策制定者和實務工作者，提供了一個實用的指南。此外，它透過突顯採購流程數位轉型所帶來的獨特挑戰和機會，為電子治理和公共部門創新的廣泛論述做出貢獻。

papers.title: Digital transformations in public welfare services: risks and benefits of digital co-production
papers.abstract: Digital technologies have the potential to transform public services by enabling digital co-production. This paper presents an illustrative case study set in the Norwegian Labour and Welfare Services (Nav) to explore how these transformations can be conceptualized and theorized. The study contributes by building an integrative framework that can be used to guide research and decision-making on digital co-production across diverse public service sectors. The framework explicates the underlying dilemmas, benefits and risks – and, consequently, the value conflicts and trade-offs involved in digital transformations centred on co-production of services.
papers.abstract_zh: 數位科技藉由促成數位協同生產，具有轉型公共服務的潛力。本文以挪威勞動暨福利服務局 (Nav) 為背景，提出一個說明性個案研究，旨在探討這些轉型如何被概念化與理論化。本研究的貢獻在於建構一個整合性架構，可用於指導跨越多元公共服務領域的數位協同生產相關研究與決策。此架構闡明了以服務協同生產為核心的數位轉型所涉及的潛在困境、效益與風險，以及隨之而來的價值衝突與權衡取捨。

papers.title: How far can participatory governance models travel? Evidence from Jordan’s decentralization reforms
papers.abstract: This article empirically critiques the mobility of participatory governance models when transferred to hybrid institutional contexts. In so doing, it critically examines Jordan’s 2017 decentralization reforms through elite interviews with 14 senior policymakers to unpack the structural conditions that impede reform. Through a blame avoidance lens, the study identifies three competing narratives on the reforms’ shortcomings, which are subsequently analyzed using the Institutional Analysis and Development framework to highlight the institutional incompatibilities that shaped reform outcomes. Despite its aims to strengthen local democracy through networked governance, the reforms produced a dysfunctional model that amplified centralization and patronage in Jordanian public administration. The study problematizes assumptions that Western governance frameworks can inherently enhance public sector performance, highlighting that successful policy transfer of participatory models in hybrid settings like Jordan is contingent on contextualization and co-design of transferred reform programs in order to synthesize external solutions with local institutional configurations.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文實證批判參與式治理模式在轉移至混合型制度脈絡時的流動性。藉此，本文透過對14位高階政策制定者的菁英訪談，批判性地檢視約旦2017年的地方分權改革，以揭示阻礙改革的結構性條件。透過規避責任的視角，本研究識別出三種關於改革缺失的相互競爭敘事，隨後再利用制度分析與發展架構進行分析，以突顯塑造改革成果的制度不相容性。儘管這些改革旨在透過網絡治理強化地方民主，卻產生了一個功能失調的模式，放大了約旦公共行政中的集權與侍從主義。本研究對西方治理架構能本質上提升公共部門績效的假設提出質疑，並強調在約旦這類混合型情境中，參與式模式的成功政策轉移，取決於轉移的改革方案之情境化與共同設計，以便將外部解決方案與當地制度配置相結合。

papers.title: Disentangling the notion of value in public services: evidence and future directions from a systematic literature review
papers.abstract: “Value” is a popular yet contested construct in Public Administration and Management (PAM) research, and has gained increasing attention in relation to the value creation process in public services. Despite the close connection between value and public services, the field lacks a clear understanding of what value is actually about and, consequently, what is created within services. We contribute to this debate through a systematic literature review of 140 records across disciplines to detect how value is defined in the field of public services and the main features of the value creation process, with a specific focus on its beneficiaries, mechanisms, levels and stages, providing an unprecedented conceptual mapping of the intersection between the concept of value and public services. We conclude by outlining several research avenues to further advance the field, calling for a shift from a theory of value creation in public services to a theory of public value creation in services.
papers.abstract_zh: 「價值」是公共行政與管理 (PAM) 研究中一個廣受關注卻也備受爭議的構念，並且在公共服務的價值創造過程中越來越受到關注。儘管價值與公共服務關係密切，該領域卻缺乏對價值究竟是什麼的清晰理解，也因此不清楚在服務中創造了什麼。我們透過對跨學科140篇文獻的系統性回顧，為此辯論做出貢獻，以探討價值在公共服務領域中如何被定義，以及價值創造過程的主要特徵，特別關注其受益者、機制、層次和階段，從而提供價值概念與公共服務交會點前所未有的概念圖譜。我們最後概述了數個研究方向以進一步推動該領域發展，並呼籲將研究重心從「公共服務中的價值創造理論」轉向「服務中的公共價值創造理論」。

papers.title: Prior beliefs and the biased interpretation of performance information: the mediating role of attention
Public service delivery under stress: The governance of funeral value-chain services during a pandemic
papers.abstract: This study examines how city-level interorganizational networks managing the funeral value chain in Barcelona, Madrid, Paris, and New York maintained service continuity during the first wave of COVID-19. Using 38 semi-structured interviews and a comparative case design, we analyze process mechanisms—viewed as drivers (facilitators) and obstacles (impediments)—and evaluate how their function varied across governance modes (shared, lead-organization, hybrid). Results show that different governance models rely on distinct mechanisms to ensure service continuity. Shared governance benefits from trust, existing relationships, and active network management, while lead-organization modes depend more on clear authority lines and open communication channels. Hybrid arrangements perform well when preexisting plans are combined with listening arenas that preserve participant voice. These insights deepen our understanding of collaborative processes in high-pressure, service-critical settings.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究探討巴塞隆納、馬德里、巴黎和紐約等城市層級的跨組織網絡，如何在COVID-19首波疫情期間，管理殯葬服務價值鏈並維持服務連續性。本研究透過38次半結構式訪談並運用比較個案設計，分析過程機制（被視為驅動因子與阻礙因子），並評估其功能在不同治理模式（共享式、主導組織式、混合式）下的差異。研究結果顯示，不同的治理模式仰賴獨特的機制來確保服務連續性。共享式治理模式受惠於信任、既有關係和積極的網絡管理，而主導組織式模式則較依賴於明確的權力線和開放的溝通管道。混合式模式在既有計畫與能夠保留參與者聲音的傾聽場域結合時，運作良好。這些見解深化了我們對在高壓且服務至關重要的情境中，協作過程的理解。

papers.title: How public managers view Sustainable Development Goals: a Q-study
Visualizing & strategizing public value: an unexpected path to invisibilizing
papers.abstract: Whereas public value has become a central concern in public management, its visibility within strategic decision-making remains a major challenge. This article examines how visual tools contribute to visualizing and strategizing public value. Drawing on an action research conducted in a French municipality, we show that issue maps shape strategizing by making public value visible, discussable, and strategically actionable. We demonstrate that these tools direct attention, support deliberation and structure meaning, creating public value. Surprisingly, they also generate resistance and processes of invisibilizing: some values become unseen. These findings highlight the inherently selective and political nature of visualizing.
papers.abstract_zh: 公共價值已成為公共管理的核心關切，然而其在策略決策中的能見度仍是一大挑戰。本文探討視覺工具如何有助於公共價值的視覺化與策略化。本文借鑒於在法國某市鎮進行的行動研究，指出議題地圖透過使公共價值變得可見、可討論且具策略行動性，從而塑造了策略制定過程。我們證明這些工具能引導注意力、支持審議並建構意義，進而創造公共價值。令人驚訝的是，這些工具也產生阻力及隱形化過程：某些價值因此變得不可見。這些發現突顯了視覺化本質上所具有的選擇性與政治性。

papers.title: Institutional context and performance-based procurement: Evidence from welfare services in three countries
papers.abstract: This study explores why similar performance-based procurement designs produce different outcomes across welfare service settings. Drawing on ten case studies from the United Kingdom, United States, and the Netherlands we develop a three-mechanism framework linking institutional context to procurement outcomes. We propose that outcomes are associated with three interacting factors: institutional distance (the structural gap between what a procurement model requires and what the existing environment provides), institutional logic alignment (the fit between market-based mechanisms and prevailing normative expectations), and organizational learning capacity (the ability of implementing organizations to adapt over time). We apply this framework to two procurement instruments: Most Economically Advantageous Tender (MEAT) and Payment by Results (PbR). Our case analysis suggests that procurement models building on existing institutional infrastructure and aligning with prevailing normative logics tend to produce more stable outcomes, while those requiring departures from established norms are more frequently associated with cream-skimming, market concentration, and implementation drift. While exploratory, these findings suggest that procurement effectiveness may depend less on the choice between MEAT and PbR than on how carefully either instrument is calibrated to its institutional environment.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討為何相似的績效導向採購設計，會在不同福利服務場域產生不同的結果。本研究以英國、美國和荷蘭的十個案例研究為基礎，發展出一個連結制度脈絡與採購結果的三機制框架。我們提出，採購結果與三個相互作用的因素相關：制度距離（採購模式所需與現有環境所能提供之間的結構性差距）、制度邏輯一致性（市場導向機制與主流規範期望之間的契合度），以及組織學習能力（執行組織隨時間推移進行調適的能力）。我們將此框架應用於兩種採購工具：最具經濟效益標案（MEAT）和依成果付費（PbR）。我們的案例分析顯示，建立在現有制度基礎設施之上並與主流規範邏輯相符的採購模式，傾向於產生更穩定的結果；而那些需要偏離既定規範的模式，則更常與篩選服務對象、市場集中化和執行偏差相關聯。儘管本研究為探索性質，這些發現指出，採購效益可能較不取決於MEAT和PbR之間的選擇，而更取決於這兩種工具如何仔細地校準其制度環境。

papers.title: Rethinking plural policing and network governance: internal and external mechanisms in the governance of security
papers.abstract: The governance of security has been studied in both criminology and public administration research, but mainly within their separate disciplines. This integrative literature review argues that governance of security research would benefit from integrating insights from both disciplines, specifically the literatures on plural policing and network governance. This results in a reconceptualization of the governance of security that distinguishes between internal and external governance mechanisms. This distinction allows for a more precise positioning of researchers in the study of governance processes and enables more specific operationalization of the governance of security to support further empirical research.
papers.abstract_zh: 安全治理在犯罪學和公共行政研究中均有探討，但主要是在各自獨立的學科範疇內進行。本整合性文獻回顧主張，安全治理研究若能整合這兩個學科的洞見，特別是多元警政和網絡治理的相關文獻，將會受益良多。本文因此對安全治理進行重新概念化，區分了內部與外部治理機制。這種區分有助於研究者在治理過程研究中更精確地定位，並能更具體地操作化安全治理，以支持進一步的實證研究。

papers.title: Social enterprises in the shadow of the State
papers.abstract: Despite growing interest in social enterprises and public value creation, little attention has been paid to how social enterprises create public value in contexts of state retrenchment and institutional voids. This paper examines FOQUS (FOndazione QUartieri Spagnoli) in Naples through a longitudinal qualitative case study. We identify three mechanisms underpinning public value creation—strategic flexibility, multi-stakeholder ecosystem governance, and storytelling—and four related challenges. Findings show that social enterprises create public value not only through collaboration with public actors but also through autonomous action in the shadow of the State, revealing tensions that characterise public value creation in institutional weak contexts.
papers.abstract_zh: 儘管對社會企業和公共價值創造的興趣日益增長，卻鮮少有研究關注社會企業如何在國家緊縮和制度空缺的背景下創造公共價值。本文透過一項縱向質性個案研究，檢視那不勒斯的FOQUS（FOndazione QUartieri Spagnoli）。我們歸納出支撐公共價值創造的三種機制——策略彈性、多元利害關係人生態系統治理和敘事——以及四項相關挑戰。研究結果顯示，社會企業不僅透過與公共行動者的協作來創造公共價值，也透過在國家權力陰影下的自主行動來達成，揭示了制度脆弱背景下公共價值創造所特有的張力。

papers.title: The balancing act of public service spaces: understanding service ecosystems and advancing the public service logic
papers.abstract: This article advances Public Service Logic (PSL) by examining how spaces are constructed and navigated within service ecosystems. In this study, ‘space’ is understood as the relational configurations through which actors coordinate, negotiate, and enable action. Based on a study of three citizen-led cross-sector support centres for cancer patients in Sweden, the findings show that the centres address unmet needs, facilitate collaboration, and navigate boundary issues with traditional patient associations. By integrating a spatial perspective into PSL, the study introduces the concept of Public Service Space to explain how cross-sector collaborations sustain service ecosystems through relational arrangements, enabling welfare provision.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文透過檢視空間如何在服務生態系統中被建構與運用，以推進公共服務邏輯 (PSL)。在本研究中，「空間」被理解為行動者藉此協調、協商並促成行動的關係配置。本研究以瑞典三個由公民主導、為癌症病患提供服務的跨部門支持中心為研究對象，研究結果顯示，這些中心解決了未滿足的需求，促進了合作，並處理了與傳統病友協會之間的邊界議題。透過將空間視角整合至公共服務邏輯 (PSL) 中，本研究引入了「公共服務空間」的概念，以解釋跨部門合作如何透過關係安排來維持服務生態系統，並促成福利提供。

papers.title: Institutional Pressures or Organizational Capacity? Antecedents of Digital Maturity in Local Governments
papers.abstract: Public administration research has identified institutional pressures and organizational capacity as digital maturity (DM) antecedents, yet these are typically considered in isolation. Taking the proverbial next step, this study draws on primary survey data to explain the variation of DM among local governments in Flanders (the northern region of Belgium) by juxtaposing the explanatory power of institutional pressures on the one hand, and political and administrative capacity on the other hand. Using multiple regression analyses, our findings highlight the critical role of administrative capacity in advancing DM among local governments. In contrast, and somewhat surprisingly, political capacity and institutional pressures appear to play a more limited role. These findings challenge conventional assumptions in existing literature, indicating that institutional pressures may catalyze the initial stages of DT, whereas organizational capacity seems to be more influential in sustaining and advancing DM.
papers.abstract_zh: 公共行政研究已指出制度性壓力與組織能力為數位成熟度 (DM) 的前因，然而這些因素通常被獨立考量。承襲此一脈絡，本研究運用第一手調查資料，透過並列比較制度性壓力，以及政治與行政能力兩者的解釋力，以解釋法蘭德斯（比利時北部地區）地方政府之間數位成熟度的差異。運用多元迴歸分析，我們的研究結果突顯行政能力在推進地方政府數位成熟度方面的關鍵作用。相較之下，且有些出乎意料地，政治能力與制度性壓力似乎扮演著較為有限的角色。這些發現挑戰了現有文獻中的傳統假設，指出制度性壓力可能催化數位轉型 (DT) 的初始階段，而組織能力似乎在維持與推進數位成熟度方面更具影響力。

papers.title: Navigating the digital transformation: unravelling the dynamic evolution of smart city collaborative governance networks
papers.abstract: Smart city initiatives, as public service innovation, represent a major evolution within state-led meta-governance, requiring complex inter-participant collaboration. Yet scholarship often treats these networks as static, missing how governance structures adapt to digital uncertainties. To fill this gap, this study employs stochastic actor-oriented models and collaborative governance theory to examine the evolution of network structures and participant attributes across 3482 smart city projects in China. Results reveal three governance patterns: government-dominated, government-SOE hybrid, and multi-stakeholder. Transitive triads, age similarity, geographic proximity, and size heterogeneity promote evolution, while outdegree constrains it. Findings guide optimizing partner selection and strengthening adaptive governance.
papers.abstract_zh: 智慧城市倡議作為公共服務創新，代表著國家主導元治理中的一項重大演進，需要複雜的參與者間協作。然而，學術界常將這些網絡視為靜態，忽略了治理結構如何適應數位不確定性。為彌補此一空缺，本研究運用隨機行動者導向模型與協作治理理論，檢視中國3482個智慧城市專案中網絡結構與參與者屬性的演化。結果揭示了三種治理模式：政府主導型、政府與國有企業混合型，以及多方利害關係人型。遞移三元組、年齡相似性、地理鄰近性及規模異質性促進了演化，而連結出度則限制了其發展。研究結果有助於優化夥伴選擇並強化適應性治理。

papers.title: Public Finance Law and Public Administrations: The Shaping Power of Public Finance in the European Union. By ElisaD'Alterio, London: Routledge, 2025. 206 pp. $56.99 (ebk). ISBN : 978‐1‐03‐274124‐6
How Front-Line Public Managers Become Institutional Entrepreneurs
papers.abstract: How do front-line public managers become institutional entrepreneurs? This article answers that question through a longitudinal single-case study of a large Norwegian municipality's healthcare services. Drawing on organizational institutionalism and public management scholarship, I first show how front-line public managers initiate divergent change by leveraging a sensing–legitimation nexus. They detect external and internal triggers, frame the need for change, and secure political, administrative, and professional support through direct negotiation and compelling operational narratives. They then act as co-creation catalysts, engaging residents and building cross-sector partnerships to adapt service designs and mobilize scarce resources. Finally, they institutionalize transformative public healthcare delivery by embedding routines in daily operations, formalizing interdisciplinary team structures, clarifying roles, and demonstrating performance gains. Evidence from two innovation projects shows that resource-constrained, non-heroic actors can disrupt entrenched practices and stabilize innovation as the new institutional arrangement. The study contributes to institutional entrepreneurship theory by positioning front-line public managers as credible entrepreneurial agents and by identifying co-creation as a core mechanism of public sector institutional change.
papers.journal: The American Review of Public Administration
papers.abstract_zh: 第一線公部門管理者如何成為制度型創業家？本文透過對挪威某大型市鎮醫療保健服務的縱貫式單一案例研究，探討此問題。援引組織制度主義與公共管理學術，本文首先闡述第一線公部門管理者如何透過運用感知-正當化連結來啟動差異化變革。他們察覺到外部與內部觸發因素，界定變革需求，並透過直接協商與具說服力的營運敘事，取得政治、行政與專業支持。接著，他們扮演共創催化劑的角色，促使居民參與並建立跨部門夥伴關係，以調整服務設計並動員稀缺資源。最後，他們透過將常規作業融入日常營運、正式化跨領域團隊結構、釐清角色，並展現績效提升，將轉型性的公共醫療保健服務制度化。來自兩個創新專案的證據顯示，資源受限的非英雄式行動者也能顛覆根深蒂固的慣例，並將創新穩定為新的制度安排。本研究透過將第一線公部門管理者定位為可信的創業行動者，並將共創識別為公共部門制度變革的核心機制，對制度型創業理論有所貢獻。

papers.title: Should we stay or should we go? Implications of trust in the municipality for second-generation migrants’ behavioural intentions towards the municipality
papers.abstract: Public and political debate increasingly problematizes the relationship between second-generation migrants and public authorities, yet little is known about how they evaluate local government. This study examines behavioural intentions towards municipalities – exit, voice, loyalty and neglect – and assesses how trust, local identification and discrimination shape these responses. Using survey data from second-generation migrants in Dutch municipalities, we find loyalty predominates, while trust, local identification and discrimination shape these orientations towards local government. These findings highlight the central role of trust and inclusion in shaping citizen–state relations and demonstrate the value of integrating migrant-centred perspectives into public administration research.
papers.abstract_zh: 公眾與政治辯論越來越將第二代移民與公共當局之間的關係視為問題，然而，對於他們如何評估地方政府卻知之甚少。本研究探討第二代移民對於地方政府的行為意圖——退出、發聲、忠誠與漠視——並評估信任、地方認同與歧視如何形塑這些回應。本研究利用來自荷蘭地方政府中第二代移民的調查數據，發現忠誠度佔主導地位，而信任、地方認同與歧視則形塑了他們對地方政府的這些傾向。這些發現突顯了信任與包容在形塑公民與國家關係中的核心作用，並證明了將以移民為中心的視角整合到公共行政研究中的價值。

papers.title: Organizational Capacity to Implement Social Equity in Emergency Management: A Local Government Perspective
papers.abstract: The emergency management profession and discipline is increasingly embracing social equity as a core value, yet limited attention has been paid to whether local emergency management organizations possess the capacity to implement equity‐focused practices. Drawing on the Capacity Building Framework, this exploratory study analyzes data from a national panel survey of US emergency managers to examine the organizational capacity to advance social equity through the lens of adaptive capacity. The findings reveal that while political, technical, financial, and managerial capacities matter, financial capacity is the most critical constraint. Respondents prioritized additional funding for personnel, community outreach and education, and the development of accessible public resources. The results highlight how resource scarcity shapes the pursuit of equity at the local level and underscores the need to align equity goals with investments in organizational capacity. This study contributes insight into the practical challenges emergency managers face in translating equity commitments into action.
papers.abstract_zh: 災害管理專業領域日益將社會公平視為核心價值，然而，卻鮮少關注地方災害管理組織是否具備實施以公平為導向之實務的能力。本探索性研究借鑒能力建構框架，分析了來自一項針對美國災害管理人員的全國性追蹤調查數據，旨在從適應性能力的視角檢視組織推進社會公平的能力。研究結果顯示，儘管政治、技術、財務和管理能力均很重要，但財務能力是最關鍵的限制因素。受訪者優先考慮為人力、社區推廣與教育以及可近用公共資源的開發提供額外資金。結果突顯了資源稀缺如何影響地方層級的公平追求，並強調了將公平目標與組織能力投資相結合的必要性。本研究為災害管理人員在將公平承諾轉化為行動方面所面臨的實際挑戰提供了見解。

papers.title: Agile Digital Transformation and the Rule of Law: Perks and Perils in a Belgian and a Dutch Public Sector Organization
papers.abstract: This paper examines the interplay between agile digital transformation and the rule of law within the public sector, focusing on case studies from a semi‐large municipal government in the Netherlands and a department of the Flemish regional government in Belgium. Drawing on expert interviews, the paper explores how agile methods, championed for flexibility, interact with existing administrative routines and affect rule of law principles that prioritize consistency. Theoretically, the paper builds on public administration scholarship concerning administrative routines and the rule of law. Empirically, the paper shows that agile methods align well with administrative routines that prioritize decentralized leadership and collaboration. Moreover, it shows that agile approaches can foster, rather than threaten, the rule of law: many legal uncertainties arise not from agile practices themselves but from existing complexities in laws and policies, highlighting a need for stronger technical precision in lawmaking and administrative awareness in digital implementation.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文探討敏捷數位轉型與公共部門法治之間的相互作用，著重於荷蘭一個中型規模市政府以及比利時法蘭德斯地區政府一個部門的案例研究。透過專家訪談，本文探討以靈活性著稱的敏捷方法，如何與既有行政慣例互動，並影響以一致性為優先的法治原則。理論上，本文立基於關於行政慣例與法治的公共行政學術研究。實證上，本文顯示敏捷方法與優先考量分權領導和協作的行政慣例高度契合。此外，本文指出敏捷方法能促進而非威脅法治：許多法律不確定性並非源於敏捷實踐本身，而是源於既有法律和政策的複雜性，凸顯了在立法上需具備更高的技術精確度，以及在數位實施中提升行政意識的必要性。

papers.title: Partisanship, Public Service Values, and Public Service Recognition Week Proclamations
papers.abstract: Since 1985, Public Service Recognition Week acknowledges the role of government employees in American democracy. Building upon the study of public service values, this research investigates gubernatorial proclamations issued in 2025, treating that years as a crucial case for the study of government employee recognition. Despite instability in the U.S. federal government, state-level proclamations illustrate a consistent emphasis on common public service values, including commitment, integrity, and professionalism. The analysis of proclamation content shows some variation in the values emphasized by the two major political parties, but no statistically discernable relationship between gubernatorial party and proclamation issuance. Still, only about one third of U.S. governors issued proclamations for Public Service Recognition Week in 2025, pointing to the need for ongoing scrutiny of employee recognition practices at the state and national level. This research closes by comparing state-level action to presidential proclamations from 1987 to 2024 and discusses implications for the application of public service value theory to the study of state government employment and employee recognition.
papers.journal: The American Review of Public Administration
papers.abstract_zh: 自1985年起，公務人員表揚週旨在肯定公務人員在美國民主體制中的角色。本研究立基於對公共服務價值觀的研究，探討2025年發布的州長文告，將該年度視為研究政府員工表揚的關鍵案例。儘管美國聯邦政府存在不穩定性，州級文告仍展現出對共同公共服務價值觀的一致強調，包括奉獻、廉正和專業精神。對文告內容的分析顯示，兩大主要政黨在強調的價值觀上存在一些差異，但州長所屬政黨與文告發布之間並無統計上顯著的關聯。然而，僅約三分之一的美國州長在2025年發布了公務人員表揚週文告，這顯示需要持續審視州和國家層級的員工表揚做法。本研究最後透過比較州級行動與1987年至2024年間的總統文告，並討論了公共服務價值理論應用於州政府僱用和員工表揚研究的意涵。

papers.title: Towards inclusive prosperity: comparative analysis of Indigenous procurement policies in Canada, Australia, and New Zealand
papers.abstract: Indigenous procurement is widely promoted as an instrument of economic reconciliation, yet headline gains often mask limited transformational impact. Applying McCrudden’s social procurement framework, we conduct a systematic cross-national comparison of identity-specific procurement architectures across Canada, Australia, and Aotearoa New Zealand. We show that contract values cluster heavily within major metropolitan hubs and narrow industry sectors, leaving remote and early-stage community enterprises marginalized. Furthermore, persistent cross-national data gaps and aggregated reporting conceal these structural inequities while enabling policy distortions like fronting. We recommend structural reforms including regional benchmarks and independent auditing to align procurement with genuine Indigenous economic sovereignty.
papers.abstract_zh: 原住民族採購被廣泛推廣為實現經濟和解的工具，然而其帳面成果往往掩蓋了有限的轉型成效。應用McCrudden的社會採購框架，我們對加拿大、澳洲和奧特亞羅瓦紐西蘭的身份特定採購架構進行了系統性的跨國比較。我們發現契約金額大量集中於主要都會區和狹窄的產業部門，使得偏遠地區及初期發展的社區企業遭到邊緣化。此外，持續存在的跨國資料缺口和彙總報告掩蓋了這些結構性不平等，同時助長了掛名行為等政策扭曲。我們建議進行結構性改革，包括區域性基準和獨立稽核，以使採購與真正的原住民族經濟主權保持一致。

papers.title: Rethinking Top Public Management Through Relational Dynamics: A Systems‐Informed Study of Senior Executives
papers.abstract: The complex nature of top public managerial work is widely acknowledged in theory but rarely examined empirically. Existing research has mostly analyzed bivariate relationships among core components of top managerial work in government, including managers' attributes, practices, outcomes, and contexts. Drawing on a systems‐based framework, we investigate how effective top managerial work unfolds as a complex relational practice. We analyze seven cases of long‐serving, distinguished Chilean senior executives through a comprehensive and process‐oriented lens, based on 27 semi‐structured interviews with the managers and members of their personal and professional networks. Our findings indicate how the relational dynamics in which senior public executives engage shape their managerial attributes and practices. Specifically, strategizing, motivation building, and technical expertise are best understood as emerging primarily through interactions within agencies and with external sociopolitical environments. These results qualify perspectives that explain senior public management effectiveness by overemphasizing executives' individual attributes and views, and underscore the need for personnel policies and governance environments that equip managers with the capacities called for by a systems approach to top public management.
papers.abstract_zh: 高階公共管理工作的複雜性在理論上廣泛被認可，卻鮮少有實證研究。既有研究主要分析了政府高階管理工作核心要素（包括管理者的特質、實踐、成果和脈絡）之間的雙變項關係。本研究援引系統取向框架，探討有效的高階管理工作如何作為一種複雜的關係實踐而展開。我們透過全面且著重過程的視角，分析了七位長期任職且表現卓越的智利高階主管案例，研究資料來自對這些主管及其個人與專業網絡成員進行的27次半結構式訪談。我們的研究結果顯示，高階公共主管所參與的關係動態塑造了他們的管理特質與實踐。具體而言，策略制定、動機建立和專業技術最能被理解為主要透過機關內部的互動以及與外部社會政治環境的互動而產生。這些結果修正了過度強調主管個人特質和觀點來解釋高階公共管理效能的觀點，並強調需要人事政策和治理環境來賦予管理者系統取向的高階公共管理所需的能力。

papers.title: Can cooperation between a city and a region lead to a robust solution during a polycrisis? – the case of Czechia
papers.abstract: The goal of this article is to explore whether municipal and regional cooperation can provide robust governance solutions during a polycrisis. The methodology of the article is based on a single-country case study from Czechia. The case study focuses on coping with the COVID-19 pandemic and the refugee crisis resulting from the war in Ukraine. We demonstrate how cooperation between a city and a region contributed to robust solutions and improved the lives of local communities. Although municipal and regional cooperation can potentially create significant positive effects that align with the definition of robust governance, this potential is not fully realized in Czechia. The main reasons for this untapped potential are failures of the central government, a lack of leadership and strategic focus, and the absence of formalized learning.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文旨在探討在複合式危機下，地方政府與區域合作能否提供穩健的治理方案。本文採用以捷克為例的單一國家個案研究方法，聚焦於因應 COVID-19 疫情以及烏克蘭戰爭所造成的難民危機。我們展示了城市與區域之間的合作如何促成穩健的解決方案，並改善了在地社群的生活。儘管地方政府與區域合作潛在能產生符合穩健治理定義的顯著正面效益，然而此潛力在捷克並未完全實現。造成此潛力未被充分發揮的主要原因為中央政府的失職、缺乏領導與策略焦點，以及缺乏制度化學習。

papers.title: Advancing the Sustainability Development Goals Through Workforce Professionalization in Public Procurement: The Case of Lebanon
papers.abstract: A capable public sector workforce is essential for sustainable development. In public procurement, the ability of procurement reform to support Sustainable Development Goals depends on a workforce with the competencies and professional standing needed to translate reform into administrative practice. Drawing on Institutional Theory and strategic PHRM, this study examines how workforce professionalization in public procurement is being constructed and institutionalized in Lebanon under Public Procurement Law No. 244 of 2021. Using a document-based qualitative case study, the study analyzes legal documents, technical reports, competency frameworks, and training materials produced between 2020 and 2025. The findings show that workforce professionalization in public procurement advanced through competency frameworks, certification initiatives, and professional training systems. However, workforce professionalization remains unevenly embedded across the civil service system. The study contributes to strategic public HRM and procurement governance scholarship and offers insight into workforce professionalization in governance-constrained settings in the Global South.
papers.abstract_zh: 稱職的公部門人力對於永續發展至關重要。在政府採購領域，採購改革能否支持永續發展目標，取決於具備所需職能與專業地位，能將改革轉化為行政實踐的人力。本研究借鑒制度理論與策略性公共人力資源管理，探討黎巴嫩在2021年第244號政府採購法下，政府採購領域的人力專業化如何被建構與制度化。本研究採用以文件為基礎的質性個案研究方法，分析2020年至2025年間產出的法律文件、技術報告、職能框架與培訓教材。研究結果顯示，政府採購領域的人力專業化透過職能框架、認證措施與專業培訓系統而推進。然而，人力專業化在公務體系中的嵌入程度仍不均勻。本研究對策略性公共人力資源管理與採購治理學術研究有所貢獻，並為全球南方治理受限場域的人力專業化提供見解。
